details.body: Nab, v. t. akasmAt Df 1 P or grah 9 U.
NAB (v.): akasmAt gfhvAti (grah, c. 9.): v. To catch, surprise.
To NAB , v. a. akasmAd grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM) or Df (c. 1. Darati, DarttuM).
NABOB: I Lit.: *nabAbaH.II Fig., a rich man: *nabAbaH; BogapatiH.
Nacre, Naker, s. muktAsPowaH, SuktipuwaM.
NACRE, NAKER: Suktyudaram (?).
NACRE , NACKER, NAKER, s. SuktipuwaM, muktAsPowaH.
Nadir, s. aDobiMduH.
NADIR: harijatalam (?).
NADIR , s. aDaHsvastikaM, aDovinduH m., aDaraH, brahmARqADoBAgaH.
Nag, s. aSvakaH, GowakaH; See Horse. v. t. kliS 9 P, ard 1 P.
NAG: I A horse: q. v.: aSvakaH.II A para- -mour: jAraH.
NAG , s. aSvakaH, aSvaH, GowakaH. See HORSE. (Paramour) jAraH.

NĀGA , s. (A demigod, having a human face with a serpent's shape. These fabulous beings are said to have sprung from Kadrū, the wife of Kaśyapa, and to have been created in order to people Pātāla, or the infernal regions.) nAgaH, kAdraveyaH, kadruputraH, kadrusutaH. The chief of these beings is called SezaH, anantaH, vAsukiH m., sarparAjaH. The following are some of the other principal Nāgas: takzakaH, padmaH, mahA padmaH, SaNKaH.
NAGATIVELY: I With denial: neti, nAstIti, etc. according to the nature of the ques- -tion.II Opp. to positively: syAnAstIti nyAyena.
Naiad, s. jaladevatA, apsaras f.
NAIAD: jaladevatA; apsaras (f.) (usually in the pl.) (= heavenly nymph).
NAIAD , s. jaladevatA, apsarAH f. (s), apsarA, nadIdevatA, udakavatI.

Nail, s. naKaH-KaM, naKaraH-raM, kararuhaH, punarBavaH, punarnavaH; ‘to fight tooth and n(ail)’ atyAveSena (naKAnaKi) vivad 1 A or yuD 4 A. 2 kIlakaH, kIlaH, SaMkuH, lohakIlaH, SaMkuH. v. t. kIl 10, (sA naScetasi kIliteva Mal. 5), kIlEH baMD 9 P; ‘n(ail)ed to the spot’ tatsTAnakIlita.

NAIL (subs.): I Lit.:(1) naKaH, to keep n.s: naKAni bimarti, M. vi. 6.; having n.s: naKin (f. nI), H. ; n. -brush: *naKamArjanI;(2) naKaraH, striking with n.s (claws): naKaprahAraH, Mah. iii. Ph.: tooth and n.: AkeSAgrAdAnaKA- ntAt, At.; on the n.: (= immediately) tat- kzaRAt.II Of metal: kIlakaH. Ph.: to hit n. on the head: marmaRi viDyati (vyaD, c. 4.).
NAIL (v.): kIlayati (kIl, c. 10.): v. To fasten.

NAIL , s. (Of the finger) naKaH, naKaraH -rA -raM, kararuhaH, karajaH, pARijaH, pARiruhaH, pARiruw m. (h), karakaRwakaH, aNgulIsamBUtaH, punarBavaH, punarnavaH, BujAkaRwaH, kAmANkuSaH; ‘a pared nail,’ KaRqakaH. [Page524-b+ 51] — (Of iron, &c.) lohakIlaH -lakaH, lOhakIlaH -lakaH, lohaSaNkuH m., kIlaH -lakaH, SaNkuH m.
To NAIL , v. a. (Fasten with nails) kIl (c. 10. kIlayati -yituM), kIlEr banD (c. 9. baDnAti, bandDuM) or vyaD (c. 4. viDyati, vyadDuM), kIlabadDaM -dDAM kf, kIlavidDaM -dDaM kf, SaNkubadDaM -dDAM kf.
NAILED , p. p. kIlitaH -tA -taM, kIlabadDaH -dDA -dDaM, SaNkupratibadDaH &c.

Naive, a. sarala, dakziRa, nirvyAja, nirvyalIka, fju, saralamati, sujana; See Frank. [Naive]ly, adv. nirvyAjaM, amAyayA, sAralyena. Naivete, s. sAralyaM, dAkziRyaM, sOjanyaM, amAyA, avyAjaH, ArjavaM, nirvyAjatA.
NAIVE: (1) saralaH (lA, laM): v. Śimple, in- -genuous;(2) prakftimaDuraH (rA, raM), K.
NAIVE , a. saralamatiH -tiH -ti, vimalArTakaH -kA -kaM, nirvyAjaH -jA -jaM, dakziRaH -RA -RaM, mAyAhInaH -nA -naM, vElakzyahInaH &c., nirvyalIkaH -kA -kaM.
NAIVELY: sahajasaralatayA; svamAvasOjanyena.
NAIVELY , adv. sAralyena, nirvyAjaM, amAyayA, dAkziRyena, avilakzitaM.
NAIVETE: (1) sahajasaralatA;(2) svaBAvasujanatA; (3) prakftimaDuratA.
NAIVETE , s. sAralyaM, saralatA, mAyAhInatA, amAyA, avyAjaH, avElakzyaM, dAkziRyaM, nirvyalIkatA, SudDamatitvaM, BAvaSudDatA.

Naked, a. nagna, vivastra, nir or a-vastra or vasana, vivasana, vivAsas, aparicCanna, digvAsas, digaMbara, vastra or vasana-hIna-rahita-SUnya; vivfta, anAvfta, anAcCAdita. 2 asajja, asaMbadDa, aBUzita. 3 kevala, anAvfta, SudDa, mAtra in comp. 4 spazwa, suprakASa, sPuwa; ‘by the n(aked) eye’ netramAtreRa; ‘a n(aked) woman’ nagnA, kowavI; ‘he would not have left me n(aked) to my enemies’ SatruprahAravaSaM-SatruvaSA-yattaM-mAM nAkarizyat. [Naked]ly, adv. nagnavat, apa-ricCannaM; kevalaM, spazwaM. [Naked]ness, s. nagnatA, nagna-BAvaH; anAvftatvaM.

NAKED: I Lit.:(1) nagna (f. gnA), what are you looking, n. woman: kiM nirIkzase nagnike, P. iv. 62.;(2) anAvftaH (tA, taM) (= not covered, bare), Mah.;(3) vivastra (f. strA) and sim. comp.s. (= without clothes), Mah.;(4) digambaraH (rA, raM) (poet), made n.: cakre digambaraH, K. s. xiii. 147.II Fig.: open, plain: anA- vftaH (tA, taM).III Mere, simple: kevalaH (lA, laM).

NAKED , a. (Having no clothes) nagnaH -gnA -gnaM, nagnakaH -kA -kaM, vivastraH -strA -straM, nirvastraH &c., avastraH &c., vastrahInaH -nA -naM, vastrarahitaH -tA -taM, vastraSUnyaH -nyA -nyaM, avAsAH -sAH -saH (s), vivAsAH &c., vivAsaH -sA -saM, digvAsAH &c., digambaraH -rA -raM, vyaMSukaH -kA -kaM, vikoSaH -SA -SaM, vivasanaH -nA -naM, vasanahInaH -nA -naM, AcCA- danahInaH -nA -naM, aparicCannaH -nnA -nnaM, aparicCadaH -dA -daM, paricCada- hInaH -nA -naM, veSahInaH -nA -naM, avaDUtaveSaH -SA -SaM, gagaRapariDAnaH -nA -naM, apariDAnaH &c., kISaH -SA -SaM, kAkarukaH -kA -kaM. — (Open, uncovered, exposed) vivftaH -tA -taM, anAvftaH -tA -taM, apavftaH -tA -taM, anAcCAditaH -tA -taM. — (Unarmed) asajjaH -jjA -jjaM, asajjitaH -tA -taM, asannadDaH -dDA -dDaM. — (Unadorned) aBUzitaH -tA -taM. — (Bare, mere) kevalaH -lA -laM, mAtrakaH -kA -kaM, mAtraM, SUnyaH -nyA -nyaM, SudDaH -dDA -dDaM; ‘it is not seen by the naked eye,’ netra- mAtreRa or kevalanetreRa na dfSyate; ‘a naked woman,’ nagnA, nagnikA, kowarI, kowavI.
NAKEDLY: I Lit.: expr. by adj.II Fig., openly: spazwam.
NAKEDLY , adv. (Without covering) vastreRa vinA, AcCAdanaM vinA, aparicCannaM, nagnavat. — (Barely) kevalaM, mAtreRa, SUnyaM.
NAKEDNESS: I Lit.:(1) nagnatvam, n. of Śiva: nagnatvaM nIlakaRWasya, H. i.;(2) digambaratvam, Ku.; etc.II Openness, exposure: anAvftatA.

NAKEDNESS , s. nagnatA -tvaM, vivastratvaM, vastrahInatA, vastraSUnyatA, vastrarA- hityaM, vasanahInatA, veSahInatA, AcCAdanahInatA, aparicCadaM, nagnaBAvaH, nagnAvasTA. — (Bareness, openness) SUnyatA, SudDatA, vivftatvaM, anAvftatvaM.

Name, s. nAman n., nAmaDeyaM; aBiDA, aBi-DAnaM, AKyA, saMjYA, aBiDeyaM, AhvayaH, AhvA, upADiH, lakzaRaM, vyapadeSaH; ‘do you know them by n(ame)’ api jYAyaMte te nAmaDeyataH; ‘I shall ask his motherʼs n(ame)’ asya mAtaraM nAmataH; pfcCeyaM (S. 7); ‘call by n(ame)’ nAma grah 9 U, saMbuD c., nAmnA Ahve 1 P; ‘calling by n(ame)’ nAmagrahaH-haRaM, saMboDanaM; ‘he calls me by my n(ame)’ nAmagrAhaM mAmAhvayati; ‘family n(ame)’ upanAma, kulanAma; ‘in oneʼs n(ame)’ vacanena, vacanAt; ‘say to the king in my n(ame)’ vAcyastvayA madvacanAtsa rAjA (R. xiv. 61); ‘what is the n(ame) of the sage’ kiMnAmaDeyosO muniH; ‘in the n(ame) of’ (in oaths) sAkzIkftya. 2 pratizWA, kIrti-KyAti-prasidDi-viSruti f., pra-, vi-, KyAtiH, yaSas n.; ‘who has made a n(ame)’ labDapratizWaH; ‘good n(ame)’ sukIrtiH, suKyAtiH; ‘bad n(ame)’ apa-a-kIrtiH, duzkIrtiH, apratizWA. v. t. aBi-DA 3 U, Ahve 1 P, AKyA 2 P, A-pra-cakz 2 A, udAhf 1 P, vyapadiS 6 P, saMjYAM-nAma-kf 8 U (with gen.); See Call; ‘hence his father n(am)ed his son Aja after the Creator’ ataH pitA brahmaRa eva nAmnA tamA-tmajanmAnamajaM cakAra (R. v. 36). 2 nAmnA nirdiS 6 P or udA-vyA-hf, nAmataH kaT 10 or vac 2 P or brU 2 U or kFt 10, nAma grah; See Tell also. [Nam]ed, ‘by name’, a. aBihita, KyAta, saMjYita, kIrtita, udAhfta, vyapa-dizwa gen. ex. by nAma ind., or by (s.) in comp.; ‘a son n(amed) Rāma’ rAmanAmA or rAmo nAma or rAmasaMjYaH putraH. 2 nAmaDArin, kfta-labDa-prApta-nAman. [Nam]ing, s. nAmakaraRaM, nAmanirdeSaH-grahaRaM. [Name]less, a. anAmaka, nAmahIna, aprasidDa. [Name]ly, adv. yaTA, nAma; ex. by tadyaTA, (viraktAnAM dviviDaM prativiDAnaM tadyaTA anugraho nigrahaSca Mu. 3). Namesake, s. eka-sama-nAmakaH, ekanAmaDArin m., sanAman m.

NAME (subs.): I Of person or thing:(1) nAman (n.), only the n. of Duryodhana remains: nAmEkaM DArtarAzwrasya Sezam, Vi.; who bear the mere n.: kevalaM nAmaDArakAH, Pa.; with (their) father's n.: pitfnAmEkapUrvakam, Y. : kept the n. of the son Chandrāpiḍa: sUnoScandrApIqa iti nAma cakAra, K. ; to call by n.: nAmagrAhamAhvayati, S. k.;(2) nAma- Deyam, asking the n.s of trees: nAmaDeyAni pfcCantO .SAKinAM, R. ; do (you) know them by n.: api jYAyante nAmaGeyataH, Mu.(3) aBiDAnam, who is this girl and what is her n.: keyaM kanyakA kimamiDAnA, K.II. Reputation, renown: q. v.: nAman, whose n. even enemies approve: nAma yasyABi- nandanti dvizo'pi, Ki. xi. 73.; bad n.: durnAma; “men of n.”: nAmaSAlinaH or KyAtanAmAnaH.III Authority: vacanam, go and in my n. rebuke: gacCa madvacanAt . upAlamasva, Sa. vi.IV In adjuration: in the n. of gods: devAn sAkzIkftya.

NAME (v. t.): I To call: q. v.: nAma karoti or kurUte (with gen.), and then should n. (him): tataSca nAma kurvIta, V. p.; therefore n.d him Aja after God: ato brahmaRo nAmnA tamajaM cakAra, R. v. 36.II To mention by n.: nAma karoti, gfhnAti (grah, c. 9.) or bravIti (brU, c. 2.), etc.; still n.s that wretch: adyApi tasyEva pApasya nAma gfhvAti, Mr. viii.III To appoint, fix.: nAmnA nirdiSati (diS, c. 6.).

NAME , s. nAma n. (n), nAmaDeyaM -yaH, saMjYA, aBiDAnaM, aBiDA, aBiGeyaM, AKyA, aBiKyA, AhvA, AhvayaH, AhvAnaM, AhvAyaH, upADiH m., aDivacanaM, lakzaRaM, vyapadeSaH; ‘bad name,’ durnAma n. (n); ‘family name,’ kulanAma n., upanAma, padDatiH -tI f.; ‘name given at birth,’ janmanAma n.; ‘from the constellation,’ nakzatranAma n.; ‘addressing by name,’ nAmagrahaH -haRaM, samboDanaM; ‘to address by name,’ nAma grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM), nAmnA aBivad (c. 1. -vadati -dituM) or aBivac (c. 2. -vakti -ktuM), samboDanaM kf; ‘giving a name,’ nAmakaraRaM; ‘bearing the name of,’ nAmaDArI -riRI &c.; ‘calling to mind the name of,’ nAmasmaraRaM; ‘forgetting the name,’ nAmavismftiH f.; ‘uttering the name of,’ nAmo- ccAraRaM; ‘abusing by name,’ nAmAparAGaH; ‘list of names,’ nAmAvaliH f.; ‘by name,’ nAmnA, nAmatas, nAma, nAmaDeyatas; ‘in my name,’ madvacanAt, mama nAmnA; ‘what is his name?’ kinnA- maGeyaH saH; ‘affix to the name of Brahmans,’ SarmmA m. (n), as vizRuSarmmA. — (Reputation) pratizWA, maryyAdA, kIrttiH f., KyAtiH f.; ‘one who has established a name,’ labGapratizWaH -zwA -zwaM; ‘good name,’ sukIrttiH f., satkIrttiH f., suKyAtiH f.; ‘bad name,’ kukI- rttiH f., duzkIrttiH f., apakIrttiH f., akIrttiH, kuKyAtiH f., aKyAtiH f. [Page525-a+ 51] amaryyAdA, kupratizWA. — (Celebrity, renown) yaSas n., viSrutiH f., KyAtiH f., viKyAtiH f., praKyAtiH f., pariKyAtiH, kIrttiH f., prasidDiH f.,

To NAME , v. a. aBiDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), AKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), kFt (c. 10. kIrttayati -yituM), prakFt, saMkFt, parikFt, anukFt, udAhf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), pracakz (c. 2. -cazwe), nAma kf or dA, saMjYAM kf; ‘they named him Rāma,’ tasya nAma rAma iti cakruH. — (Mention by name) nAma grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM), nAmagrahaRaM kf, nAmnA aBivad (c. 1. -vadati -dituM), nAmodAharaRaM kf, sambuD (c. 10. -boDayati -yituM), samboDanaM kf, nAmanirdeSaM kf, nAmoccAraRaM kf, nAmasmaraRaM kf.

NAMED (adj.): (1) nAma (rarely nAmnA = by name); n. Vimardaka: vimardako nAma, D. ii.; a town n. Valabhi: valamI nAma nagarI, D. vi.; (2) by comp., of a swan n. Karpūrakeli: karpUrakelinAmno rAjahaMsasya, H.: v. Also to call.

NAMED , p. p. aBihitaH -tA -taM, AKyAtaH -tA -taM, proktaH -ktA -ktaM, saMjYitaH -tA -taM, udAhftaH -tA -taM, pratyudAhftaH -tA -taM, kIrttitaH -tA -taM, pari- kIrttitaH -tA -taM, vyapadizwaH -zwA -zwaM, smftaH -tA -taM, nAmABihitaH -tA -taM; the following may be used in composition: nAmakaH -kA -kaM, nAmA -mnI -ma, aBiDAnaH -nA -naM, aBiDaH -DA -DaM, AKyaH -KyA -KyaM, AhvaH -hvA -hvaM, AhvayaH -yA -yaM, nAmaDeyaH -yA -yaM, saMjYaH -jYA -jYaM; as, ‘a king named Suvarna,’ suvarRAKyo rAjA; ‘in a city named Kānchanapur,’ kAYcanapuranAmni nagare; ‘a prince named Śūdraka,’ SUdrakanAmA nfpatiH; ‘named Vibhī- shana,’ viBIzaRABiDaH or viBIzaRABiDAnaH; ‘a woman named Chandrā,’ candrAnAmnI strI. Sometimes the adverb nAma is used as suvarRo nAma rAjA, candrA nAma strI. — (Having a name) saMjYAvAn -vatI -vat (t), prAptanAmA -mA -ma (n), labDanAmA &c., prAptA- BiDAnaH -nA -naM, nAmaDArI -riRI -ri (n), nAmaDArakaH -kA -kaM; ‘is named,’ aBiDIyate, KyAyate, AKyAyate.
NAMELESS: (1) anAmakaH (kA, kaM);(2) nAmahInaH (nA, naM) and sim. comp.s.: v. Name.
NAMELESS , a. anAmakaH -kA -kaM, nAmahInaH -nA -naM, nAmarahitaH -tA -taM, anaBiDAnaH -nA -naM, anAmA -mA -mnI -ma (n), aprasidDaH -dDA -dDaM.

NAMELY: animals are of two kinds, n., worldly and free: jIvA dviviDAH saMsAriRo muktASca, D. s. iii.; some say truths are seven, n., animate and inani- mate beings, allurement, bond, control, casting off and emancipation: kecana sapta tattvAnIti varRayanti, tadAha jIvAjIvAsravabanDasaMvaranirjaramokzAstattvAnIti, D. s.; there are two ways of correcting disaffective peo- ple, n., favour and chastisement: iha Kalu viraktAnAM prakftInAM dviviDaM prativiDAnam, tadyaTAnugraho nigrahaSce ti; it is of two kinds, n., visible and invisible: tad dviviDaM dfzwAdfzwaBedAt, D. s. xi.
NAMELY , adv. nAma, nAmatas, yaTA, arTatas, arTAt, yaTAkramaM.
NAMESAKE: (1) sanAman (mfn.);(2) samanAman (mfn.).
NAMESAKE , s. samanAmakaH, samanAmaDArI m. (n), ekanAmakaH.
NAMING (subs.): (1) nAmakaraRam;(2) nAmagrahaRam; etc.: v. Name.
NAMING , s. (Giving a name) nAmakaraRaM, nAmasTApanaM. — (Mentioning by name) nAmagrahaH -haRaM, nAmanirdeSaH, nAmoccAraRaM.

Nap, s. alpa-svalpa-nidrA, adIrGanidrA. 2 ro(lo)man n. 3 gaMqaH. v. i. ‘take a n(ap)’ alpakAlamAtraM svap 2 P. [Nap]less, a. loma-hIna. [Nap]py, a. lomaSa, lomamaya (yI f.). 2 nidrAlu. 3 svApa or nidrA-kArin or Avaha.
NAP (subs.): I A short sleep: svalpanidrA (?): v. Sleep.II Down: loman (n.) (?).
NAP (v.): svalpaM or kzaRa svapiti (svap, c. 2.) (?): v. To sleep.
NAP , s. (Short sleep) alpanidrA, adIrGanidrA, adIrGasvapnaH, vAmakukziH f. — (Down) loma n. (n), roma n. (n).
To NAP , v. n. alpanidrAM kf, adIrGanidrAM kf, alpakAlamAtraM svap (c. 2. svapiti -tuM), adIrGakAlaM svap.
Nape, s. manyA, GAwA, avawuH, kfkAwikA.
NAPE: of the neck: (1) GAwAH(2) kfkAwikA; (3) avawuH: To turn by the n.: ardDacandraM dattvA niHsArayati, P.
NAPE , s. (Of the neck) manyA, manyAkA, kanDaraH -rA, grIvA, GAwaH -wI -wikA, kfkAwikA, kalambikA, sImA m. (n), paScAdgrIvA SirA.
Napkin, s. muKa-vadana-mArjanavastraM, naktakaH.
NAPKIN: *muKamArjanI and sim. comp.s.
NAPKIN , s. muKamArjanI, vadanamArjanI, varakaM, naktakaH.
NAPLESS: jIrRa (f. rRA) (= decayed, old): v. Threadbare.
NAPLESS , a. lomahInaH -nA -naM, nirlomA -mA -ma (n), avidyamAnalomA &c.
NAPPY , a. lomaSaH -SA -SaM, bahulomA -mA -ma (n), lomamayaH -yI -yaM. — (Frothy) PenalaH -lA -laM, PenilaH -lA -laM.

NARBADĀ , s. (River, which rises in the Vindhyā mountain called Amrakūta, and runs westward about 750 miles into the gulf of Cambay below Baroche) narmmadA, revA, somasutA, somodBavA, meKalakanyakA, mekalakanyakA, mekalAdrijA, meKalA, pUrvvagaNgA.
NARCISSUS: lArkasAKye puzpe, tatprasavinyAM latAyAYca.
Narcotic, a. nidrA or svApa-kArin or janana (nI f.). s. nidrAvahaM OzaDaM, nidrOzaDaM.
NARCOTIC, -AL (adj.)): (1) nidrAdAyin (f. nI); (2) svapnakaraH (rI, raM).
NARCOTIC (subs.): upavizam, ‘sapta vizajAtayaH’, Bha.
NARCOTIC , a. svapnakArI -riRI -ri (n), svapnakft m. f. n., nidrAkArI &c., nidrAkft m. f. n., nidrAjanakaH -kA -kaM, upaSAyI -yinI &c., upaSamanakArI &c.
NARCOTIC , s. nidrAjanakam OzaDaM, upaSamanaM, grAhI m. (n), upavizaM.
Nard, s. jawilA, jawAmAMsI, tapasvinI, lomaSA, miSI(zI).
NARD: (1) naladam;(2) jawAmAMsI;(3) jawilA.
NARD , s. jawilA, jawAvatI, jawAmAMsI, jawAlA. See SPIKENARD.

Narrate, v. t. varR 10, pari-kFt 10, kaT 10, AKyA 2 P, ni-A-vid c., aBi-DA 3 U, vyAhf 1 P, vad 1 P, cakz 2 A; See Tell. Narration, s. kIrtanaM, kaTanaM, varRanaM, AKyAnaM, nivedanaM. 2 kaTA; See below. [Narrat]ive, s. kaTA, A-upA-KyAnaM, AKyAyikA, vfttAMtaH, caritraM, kaTAprabaMDaH; itihAsaH. a. kaTAsaMbaM-Din, kaTA in comp., vivaraRavizayaka. [Narrat]or, s. nivedakaH, kaTakaH.
NARRATE: varRayati, upa-, (varR, c. 10.): v. To relate, describe.

To NARRATE , v. a. kaT (c. 10. kaTayati -yituM), saNkaT, AKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), samAKyA, KyA in caus. (KyApayati -yituM), nivid (c. 10. [Page525-b+ 51] -vedayati -yituM), Avid, varR (c. 10. varRayati -yituM), upavarR, anuvarR, saMvarR, SaMs (c. 1. SaMsati -situM), Sru (c. 10. NATIONAL: (1) deSa- in comp., n. language: deSaBAzA;(2) deSIyaH (yA, yaM), n. dress: deSIyavezaH.

(Pertaining to a nation) dESikaH -kI -kaM, deSIyaH -yA -yaM, deSyaH -SyA -SyaM, deSI -SinI -Si (n), jAtIyaH &c., rAzwrIyaH &c., rAzwrikaH -kI -kaM, rAzwriyaH -yA -yaM, deSa in comp.; ‘national custom,’ deSavyavahAraH, deSAcAraH; ‘national law,’ deSaDarmmaH, janapa- daDarmmaH; ‘national calamity,’ rAzwraM, utpAtaH. — (Proud of one's own country) svadeSABimAnI -ninI -ni (n), svalokABimAnI &c., svarAzwrABimAnI &c.; ‘national pride,’ deSABimAnaM. — (General) sAmAnyaH -nyA -nyaM, sarvvasAmAnyaH &c., sADAraRaH -RI -RaM, sarvvajanIyaH -yA -yaM.

(n); ‘astrological calculation of nativity,’ jAtakaM; ‘astro- logical record of it,’ janmapatraM -trikA; ‘month of one's na- tivity,’ janmamAsaH; ‘name given at it,’ janmanAma n. (n), nakzatra- nAma; ‘star of one's nativity,’ janmanakzatraM; ‘sign,’ janmarASiH m., janmalagnaM.

NATRON , s. sarjjiH f., sarjjikA, sarjjikAkzAraH, sfjikAkzAraH, kzAraH, kApotaH, sOvarccalaH, SruGnikA, suKavarcakaH.

NATURAL , s. (Idiot) yaTAjAtaH, jaqaH, mUQaH, nyUnabudDiH m.

To NATURALIZE , v. a. deSajADikAraM dA, deSIyaM, -yAM kf, dESikaM -kAM kf. — (Render familiar) aByas (c. 4. -asyati -asituM), aByAsena sugamaM -mAM kf.

NATURALLY: I By nature:(1) by comp., for bad men are n. not friend of the good: prakftyamitrA hi satAmasADavaH, Ki.; n. complaisant: nisargadakziRa (f. RA), Si. xv. 68.;(2) svamAvataH; (3) prakftyA;(4) nisargeRa.II By birth: q. v.: janmanA.III Without addition: a new cloud is n. beautiful: kevalo'pi suBago navAmbudaH, R. ii. 80.; pearls are n. pleasing to the eye: prAgeva muktA nayanABirAmAH, R. xvi. 69.IV Sponta- -neously: svataH, good men are n. bent for others: svata eva satAM parArTatA, N. ii. 61. V. As a natural consequence: perh. svata eva: v. Indis- -putably, necessarily.

NATURALLY , adv. (According to nature) svaBAvatas, svaBAvena -vAt, prakftitas, prakftyA, BAvatas, svaBAvAnusAreRa, jAtitas, janmatas, guRatas. — (Regularly, according to the proper course) yaTAkramaM, yaTA- yogyaM, yaTAmArgaM. — (Not affectedly) yaTArTaM, avElakzpeRa. — (Not forcedly) aklizwaM, ayatnapUrvvaM, sahajagatyA, sahajaSaktyA. — (Sponta- neously) svatas, svayaM; ‘done naturally,’ svayaNkftaH -tA -taM; ‘very naturally,’ svaBAvenEva.
NATURALNESS , s. svABAvikatvaM, prAkftatvaM, sahajatvaM, akftrimatA. — (Confor- mity to reality) yaTArTatA, yATAtaTyaM, satyatA, avElakzyaM, saralatA, sAralyaM.

Nature, s. sfzwi f., jagat n., BUmaMqalaM, viSvaM, brahmAMqaM, sargaH. 2 mArgaH, rIti f., kramaH, viDiH, niyamaH, DarmaH, sfzwikramaH. 3 prakfti f., mAyA, Sakti f., nirmAtrI devatA, AdiSaktiH-mAyA, praDAnaM (according so Sānkhyas). 4 prakAraH, rUpaM, jAti f., rItiH, viDA, in comp. 5 BAvaH, prakftiH, svaBAvaH, nisargaH, DarmaH, tattvaM, sattvaM, guRaH, prakfti-nisarga-jAti-svaBAvaH saMsidDi f., svarUpaM, svaDarmaH; SIlaM. 6 svaBAva or prakfti-guRaH or DarmaH; ‘preperties of n(ature)’ guRatrayaM (sattvaM, rajaH, tamaH); ‘good n(ature)’ sadBAvaH, suSIlaM, sOjanyaM; ‘of this n(ature)’ evaMviDa; ‘by n(ature)’ prakftyA, jAtyA, janmataH, svaBAvataH; ‘blind by n(ature)’ janmAMDa, jAtyaMDa, januzAMDa; ‘functions of n(ature)’ deha-SarIra-DarmaH. [Natur]ed, a. svaBAva, SIla, prakfti in comp. Natural, a. svABAvika-nEsargika-sAMsidDika-prAkftika-sAhajika-Otpattika (kI f.), sahaja, svaBAva-nisarga-ja svaBAva-prakfti-sidDa, sva, nija, aMtarBava, aM-tarjAta, prakftisTa; ‘n(atural) enemy’ jAtaSatru sahajAriH; ‘n(atural) enmity’ SASvatikaH viroDaH; oft. ex. by (s.); svaBAva evEza paropakAri-RAm (S. 5) ‘it is n(atural) with the benevolent’. 2 yogya, yaTAmArga-nyAya, yukta, ucita. 3 svaBAvAnugata, anuloma, prakftyanu-sArin, svaBAvayogya. 4 akftrima, akftaka, ayatnakfta, ayatnanirmita; ‘n(atural) cavity’ deva-KAtaM; ‘n(atural) loveliness’ avyAjasOMdaryaM. 5 aklizwa, ayatnakfta, sulaBa. 6 (Child) gUQaja, anOrasa (sI f.), jAraja, upastrIjAta, vijAta; See Illegltimate. 7 satya, yaTArTa, sarala, akftrima, prakfta. 8 yaTAkAlaH ‘n(atural) death’ yaTAkAlaM maraRaM; ‘n(atural) day’ sAvana-dinaM; ‘n(atural) form’ svarUpaM; ‘n(atural) disposition’ svaBAvaH, janmasvaBAvaH; ‘n(atural) history’ jaqAjaqa-SAstraM, sTAvarajaMgamaSAstraM; ‘n(atural) philosophy’ padArTavijYAnaM; ‘n(atural) to’ sulaBa; ‘levity n(atural) to mortals’ mAnuzatAsulaBo laGimA (Ka. 134). s. mUQaH, mUrKaH, jaqaH. [Natural]ist, s. padArTa-SAstrajYaH, padArTavijYAnin m. [Natural]ize, v. t. aByas 4 U; See Familiarize. 2 deSIya a. kf 8 U. [Natural]ly, adv. prakftyA, nisargeRa, svaBAvataH, svaBAvena, nisargataH, jAtyA, (s.) in comp.; ‘n(aturally) charming’ nisargamaDura, prakftisuBaga, avyAjasuMdara-manohara, &c. 2 yaTAkramaM, anu-lomaM, sfzwikramAnusAreRa. 3 akftrimaM, aklizwaM, ayatnataH, sahajaSaktyA-gatyA. 4 svataH, svayaM, aMtaHpravfttyA, abalAt, sahajAvaboDena. 5 avaSyaM, nirvivAdaM, niyataM, anAyAsenEva; nUnaM, Kalu. [Natural]ness, s. sahajatvaM, akftakatA, yATArTyaM, &c.

NATURE: I The creation, the universe: q. v.: sfzwiH.II The original cause: prakftiH. III Kind, sort: q. v.: prakAraH.IV Subs- -tance, purport: q. v.: BAvaH. V. Natural constitution:(1) svaBAvaH, for n. is at the head above all qualities: atItya hi guRAn sarvAn svamAvo mUrDni vartate, H.;(2) prakftiH, it is the n. of the great: prakftiH Kalu sA mahIyasaH, Ki.;(3) nisargaH (mostly as =adv.), this grove is beautiful by n.: nisargaramaRIyo'yamArAmaH, Pra.;(4) BAvaH in comp., of impure n.: aSudDaBAvaH (vA, vaM) Mah.;(5) SIlam (mostly in comp.), for it is the n. of inebriety and insanity: SIlaM hi madonmAdayoH, D. ii.; bad n.d: duHSIlaH (lA, laM). VI Essential n.: svarUpam, n. of the soul: AtmasvarUpam, S. vii. Ph.: to attend to, satisfy a call of n.: mEtraM karoti, V. p. iii. 13. 8.; SOcaM karoti, Mah. s. 193. 4.

NATURE , s. (The goddess who is the material cause of the world and all created things. According to the Hindū mythology this goddess is unreal, and identified with Māyā or Illusion, and sometimes with the Śakti or per- sonified energy, or wife of a deity. She is in an especial manner the prototype of the female sex. Hence the following names for her) prakftiH f., mAyA, mahAmAyA, AdimAyA, mAyAdevI, praDAnaM, SaktiH f., AdiSaktiH f., liNgaM, avidyA, durgA, lakzmIH f.; ‘the illusion practised by nature,’ mAyAjAlaM; ‘sleight of nature,’ mAyAlAGavaM. — (Essence, essential pro- perties which constitute a thing) BAvaH, svaBAvaH, prakftiH f., [Page527-a+ 51] prakftiBAvaH, nisargaH, sargaH, sfzwiH f., saMsidDiH f., rUpaM, svarUpaM, DarmmaH, svaDarmmaH, sattvaM, vastu n., vastusvaBAvaH, nisargaBAvaH, AtmA, jAtisvaBAvaH, samIkzA, tattvaM, guRaH; the three ‘gunas’ or properties of nature are, 1. ‘existence or truth,’ sattvaM; 2. ‘foulness or passion,’ rajas n.; 3. ‘darkness,’ tamas n. — (Natural dis- position or temper of mind) svaBAvaH, prakftiH f., SIlaH -latA, sahajaH -jaM, sahajaBAvaH, sahajaSIlaH; ‘good-nature,’ sadBAvaH, suSIlaH, sADuSIlatvaM. — (Natural form) svarUpaM, sahajarUpaM, prakftiH f., nisargaH. — (Established, regular course of things) mArgaH, rItiH f., kramaH, prakftimArgaH, sfzwerItiH f., sfzwikramaH. — (System of created things) sfzwiH f., sargaH, jagat n., viSvajagat n., BUmaRqalaM, brahmamfzwiH, viSvaM. — (Natural feelings, affections or qualities) svaBAva- guRAH m. pl., prakftiguRAH m. pl., svaBAvaDarmmaH, prakftiDarmmaH, prakftiBAvaH. — (Constitution, vital power of a body) jIvanaSaktiH f., SaktiH f., jIvitvaSaktiH f., ojas n., prARAH m. pl., prARabalaM, dehasvaBAvaH, SarIrasTitiH f. — (Sort, kind) prakAraH, jAtiH f., rUpaM, rItiH f. — (Law of action) viDiH m., viDAnaM, niyamaH, sTitiH f., DarmmaH; ‘by nature,’ svaBAvena, jAtyA, janmatas. See NATURALLY. ‘Blind by nature,’ janmAnDaH -nDA -nDaM, jAtyanDaH &c., garBAnDaH &c.; ‘offices of nature,’ dehaDarmmaH, SarIraDarmmaH; ‘relieving nature,’ malavisargaH, malotsargaH, malamUtravisarjanaM.
NATURED: by comp., good n.: suSIlaH (lA, laM).
NATURED , a. (Used in composition) expressed by svaBAvaH -vA -vaM, SIlaH -lA -laM, prakftiH -tiH -ti; as, ‘good-natured,’ suSIlaH -lA -laM; ‘ill-natured,’ duzprakftiH -tiH -ti.
NAUFRAGE , s. (Shipwreck) nOBaNgaH, nOBedaH, nOkABaNgaH.
Naught, s. na kimapi, na kiMcit-kiMcana. 2 SUnyaM, KaM; ‘set at n(aught)’ avajYA 9 U, tfRIkf 8 U; See Contemn, Defy. adv. na kimapi, na kiMcidapi, na Izadapi-sto-kamapi. a. asAra, nirguRa.
NAUGHT (subs.): SUnyam. To set at n.: na tfRAya manyate (man, c. 4.).
NAUGHT (adj.): akiYcitkaraH (rI, raM).
NAUGHT , s. na kiYcit, na kiYcana, na kimapi, avastu. — (In arithmetic) SUnyaM, caH; ‘to set at naught,’ avajYA (c. 9. -jAnAti -jYAtuM), laGUkf. See To CONTEMN.
NAUGHT , adv. na kiYcit, na kiYcidapi, na kimapi.
NAUGHT , a. nirguRaH -RA -RaM, asAraH -rA -raM, viguRaH -RA -RaM.
NAUGHTILY , adv. pratIpaM, pratIpavat, duzwaM, duzwaBAvena, pratIpaSIlatvAt.

NAUGHTY: duzwaH (zwA, zwaM): V. Also vicious.
NAUGHTY , a. pratIpaH -pA -paM, vipratIpaH -pA -paM, avaSyaH -SyA -SyaM, avineyaH -yA -yaM, mandacaritraH -trA -traM, duzwacaritraH &c., duzwaH -zwA -zwaM, durvfttaH -ttA -ttaM.
NAULAGE , s. taramUlyaM, tarapaRyaM, tArikaM, tAryyaM, AtaraH, AtAraH.
Naumachy, s. nOyudDaM.
NAUMACHY , s. nOyudDaM, nOkAyudDaM, nAvikayudDaM, nOyudDakOtukaM.

Nausea, s. vamanaM, utkledaH, vamanecCA. 2 vEkftaM, bIBatsaH, kutsA, GfRA, nirvedaH. Nauseate, v. i. vam desid. (vivamizati). v. t. Abhor, q. v. Nauseous, a. bIBatsAvaha, bIBatsa, nirvedaprada, garhita, kutsita. 2 vama-notpAdin.

NAUSEA , s. (Sickness) vamanecCA, vivamizA, utkleSaH, utkledaH. — (Loathing, disgust) bIBatsaH -tsaM, vikftaM, vEkftaM, vEkftyaM, vikAraH, kutsA, vira- ktiH f., nirvedaH.

To NAUSEATE , v. n. (Be inclined to vomit) vam in des. (vivami- zati -zituM), vamanecCuH -cCuH -cCu BU, vivamizuH -zuH -zu BU.
To NAUSEATE , v. a. bAD in des. (bIBatsate -tsituM), GfR (c. 1. GfRate -RituM).
NAUSEATED , p. p. bIBatsena parityaktaH -ktA -ktaM.
NAUSEOUS: jugupsitaH (tA, taM): v. Loathesome.

NEAP , a. (Low) nIcaH -cA -caM, nimnaH -mnA -mnaM; ‘neap tide,’ nimnavelA, nIcavelA.

Near, prep. samIpaM-pe (with gen.), ArAt (with abl.), samayA, nikazA (with acc.), upa in comp.; (with verbs) ex. by upa, A, aBi, prati. a. Asanna, pratyAsanna, sannihita, samIpa, nikawa, samIpa-nikawa-sTa, upAMta, aMtika, samIpa-nikawa-vartin, upakaMWa saMnikfzwa, saviDa, aByAsa-Sa, sadeSa, saveSa, aByarRa, aByagra, sanIqa, samaryAda, adUra; ‘quite n(ear)’ saMsakta, avyavahita, apadAMtara; ‘very n(ear)’ nedizWa; aMtikatama. 2 dfQasaMbadDa-saMsakta, paricita. 3 svArTasaMbaMDin. 4 kfpaRa, alpavyayin; (relation) nikawa, Asanna; ‘who is n(ear) her delivery’ AsannaprasavA; ‘n(ear) his death’ AsannamftyuH. adv. samIpaM-pe, aMtikaM-ke, nikawaM-we, aBitaH, upAMte, ArAt, nikazA, adUraM-re, saMniDO, sakASe, upa in comp.; ‘n(ear) at oneʼs side’ pArSve, pArSvataH. 2 Nearly; See below. v. i. upa-gam 1 P, upasf 1 P, samIpaM-gam; See Approach. NEAR (prep.): (1) upa- in comp., n. Bhaimī: upaBEmi, N.;(2) ArAt (with abl.), n. the forest: ArAdvanAt, S. k.;(3) nikazA (with acc.), n. Lankā: laNkAM nikazA, Si.;(4) samayA (with acc.): v. Near (adj. and adv.).

QA) (rare).III Inti- -mate, dear: q. v.: Asanna (f. nnA) (?), does not admit me in n. concerns: na mAmAsannakAryezva- ByantarIkaroti, D. viii.IV Of roads: perh. Asanna (f. nnA); sannihita (f. tA): v. (Require) AkAMkz (c. 1. -kAMkzati -kzituM), AkAMkz, aBikAMkz, apekz (c. 1. -Ikzate -kzituM), prArT (c. 10. -arTayati -yituM), arh (c. 1. arhati -rhituM), often expressed by prayojanaM, upayogaH or kAryyaM; as, ‘the healthy need not a physician,’ nirAmayARAM cikitsakena prayojanaM nAsti; ‘he needs me,’ tasya mayA prayojanaM. NEEDED , p. p. AkAMkzitaH -tA -taM, apekzitaH -tA -taM, prayojanIyaH -yA -yaM.

NEEDLE-WORK: (1) sUtrakarman (n.);(2) sUci- karman (n.).

NEEDLESLY , adv. prayojanaM vinA, nizprayojanaM, akAraRaM, nizkAraRaM, kAraRaM [Page529-b+ 51] vinA, hetunA vinA, hetuM vinA, ahetukaM, nirarTakaM, vyarTaM.
NEEDLESNESS , s. ahetutA -tvaM, akAraRatvaM, akAraRaM, aprayojakatvaM, aprayojanaM, nizkAraRatvaM, prayojanABAvaH, kAraRABAvaH.
NEEDLESS: (1) nizprayojanaH (nA, naM);(2) nirarTakaH (kA, kaM).

NEEDY: (1) niHsva (f. svA);(2) dInaH (nA, naM): v. Poor.
NEEDY , a. daridraH -drA -draM, nirDanaH -nA -naM, aDanaH -nA -naM, dInaH -nA -naM, durgataH -tA -taM, arTahInaH -nA -naM, vittahInaH &c., arTI -rTinI -rTi (n).
Nefarious, a. atiGora, atiduzwa, niMdya, dAruRa, duzwatama, pApizWa, mahA-ati-pAtakin. [Nefarious]ly, adv. atiGoraM, atiduzwatayA. [Nefarious]ness, s. atiGoratA, pApizWatA.

NEGATIVE (v.): I To disapprove: pratyAKyAti (KyA, c. 2.), S.II. To reject: pratikzipati (kzip, c. 6.), D. s.

(Implying denial) apalApI -pinI -pi (n), nihnava- sUcakaH -kA -kaM, nihnavArTakaH -kA -kaM, apavAdakaH -kA -kaM, asvIkAra- sUcakaH &c., nizeDasUcakaH &c., nizeDArTakaH -kA -kaM. — (Implying absence, privative) aBAvamUcakaH -kA -kaM, aBAvarUpaH -pA -paM, aBAvAtmakaH -kA -kaM, aBAvadarSakaH -kA -kaM, akaraRarUpaH -pA -paM, akara- RAtmakaH -kA -kaM, ananuzWAnarUpaH -pA -paM. — (Stopping by non- consent) nizeDadvArA pratibanDakaH -kA -kaM.

(Word) asvIkArasUcakaSabdaH, nizeDasUcakaSabdaH, apalA- pasUcakaSabdaH, nizeDArTakaSabdaH, asvIkAraSabdaH. — (Proposition by which something is denied) aBAvasUcakapakzaH, aBAvasUcakavAkyaM, nizeDasUcakapakzaH, nAstipakzaH, aBAvapakzaH. — (Right of preventing) nizeDADikAraH, nizeDaSaktiH f., pratibanDasAmarTyaM.

NEGATIVELY , adv. asvIkAreRa, sanizeDaM, sApalApaM, sApavAdaM, aBAvarUpeRa.

(Omit) tyaj (c. 1. tyajati, tyaktuM), parityaj, aticar (c. 1. -carati -rituM), laNG (c. 10. laNGayati -yituM), vilaNG, ullaNG, atikram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), vyatikram, ativft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), hA (c. 3. jahAti, hAtuM), apahA, apAs (c. 4. -asyati -asituM), utsfj (c. 6. -sfjati -srazwuM), atisfj, vyapasfj. — (Be careless about) pramad (c. 4. -mAdyati -madituM), na avaDA (c. 3. -Datte -DAtuM), anavaDAnaM kf, pramAdAt parityaj; ‘he neglects his duty,’ svaDarmmAt pramAdyati. — (Not to perform) na anuzWA (c. 1. -tizWati -zWAtuM), ananuzWAnaM kf, na kf. — (Forget to perform) vismf (c. 1. -smarati -te -smarttuM), na smf, apasmf, vismaraRAt parityaja. — (Disregard) upekz (c. 1. -Ikzate -kzituM), samupekz, upaprekz, na sev (c. 1. sevate -vituM), asevanaM kf. — (Slight) avajYA (c. 9. -jAnAti -jYAtuM), avaman (c. 4. -manyate -mantuM), avaDIr (c. 10. -DIrayati -yituM), avagaR (c. 10. -gaRayati -yituM), anAdaraM kf, [Page530-a+ 51] KalIkf; ‘he neglects to honor the honorable,’ pUjyapUjAvya- tikramaM karoti.

(Omission, forbearing to do any thing) tyAgaH, parityAgaH, ananuzWAnaM, upAtyayaH, atipAtaH, paryyayaH, anaByAsaH, avakriyA, lopaH, parilopaH, apAsanaM, utsarjanaM, atisarjanaM, atikramaH, vyatikramaH, ativarttanaM, laNGanaM, vilaNGanaM, aticAraH. — (Carelessness, inatten- tion) pramAdaH, pramAdyaM, pramattatA, anavaDAnaM. — (Forgetfulness) vismftiH f., vismaraRaM. — (Disregard) upekzA, anapekzA, anavekzA, nirapekzA, utprekzA, udBAvanaM, adarSanaM. — (Slighting) avajYA, avamAnaM, anAdaraH, amAnanaM, avaDIraRaM, avapAlanaM.

NEGLIGENCE: (1) SETilyam;(2) upekzA (= neg- -lect).
NEGLIGENCE , s. anavaDAnaM -natA, pramAdaH, pramAdyaM, pramattatA, anavahitatvaM, upekzA, anapekzA, anavekzA, asamIkzA, avyavasAyaH, bAliSyaM. See NEGLECT.
NEGLIGENT: (1) expr. by verb. or subs., he is n. of his duties: kftyAni sa upekzate or nAdriyate; (2) anavahitaH (tA, taM): v. Needless, careless. (3) SiTilaH (lA, laM) (= slack).

NEGOTIABLE , a. paRitavyaH -vyA -vyaM, paRAyitavyaH &c., vyavaharttavyaH &c., vyavahAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, vyavahArayogyaH -gyA -gyaM, vyavasAyayogyaH &c.

[Negotiat]ion, s. paRanaM, vyavahAraH. 2 saMDikramaH, sAman n., SamanaM, maDyasTASrayaH. [Negotiat]or, s. vyavahArin m., paRikaH, vyavahatf m. 2 maDyasTaH, saMDi-sAma-vid m. sAmakuSalaH.

NEGOTIATOR: dUtaH (= ambassador); (2) maDyasTaH (= middle man);(3) vyavahartf (m.) (= trans- -actor).
Negro, s. SyAmadehaH, kfzRAMgaH.
NEGRO: *hApsin (m.), Negress: *hApsinI.
NEGRO , s. SyAmadehaH, SyAmaSarIraH, SyAmANgaH, kfzRadehaH, kfzRANgaH.
NEGUS: pAnIyaviSezaH; mEreyam; (??) *mADavaM maDu.

To NEIGH , v. n. hrez (c. 1. hlezate -zituM) or hlez, hez (c. 1. hezate -zituM), rez (c. 1. rezate -zituM), aSvavad ru (c. 2. rOti, ravituM) or nad (c. 1. nadati -dituM) or nAdaM kf or citkAraM kf.

(n), samIpavAsI m., nikawasTaH, samIpasTaH, samIpasTAyI m., prativeSavAsI m., prativeSI m., prativeSikaH, sAmantavAsI m., samIpadeSanivAsI janaH, samIpagfhavAsI m., sAmantaH, aDivAsaH, saMsTaH, saMsTitaH; ‘a next- door neighbor,’ nirantaragfhavAsI m., prAtiveSyaH; ‘next but one,’ [Page530-b+ 51] anuveSyaH; ‘one should love one's neighbor as one's self,’ AtmOpamyena parasmin dayAM kuryyAt.

(Vicinity, adjoining district) sAmantadeSaH, sAmantaM, samIpadeSaH, samIpasTAnaM, prativeSaH, sanniveSaH, aDivAsaH, antikaM, upAntyaM, nikarzaRaH. — (State of being near, proximity) samIpatA, sAmIzyaM, nikawatA, nEkawyaM, sanniDAnaM, sAnniDyaM, sanniDiH m., sanniDaM, sannikarzaH, sannikfzwatA, AsannatA, antikatA, antikaM, upAntaM -ntyaM, pratyA- sannatA, pratyAsattiH f., sAmantatvaM, nikawavarttitvaM, samIpavarttitvaM, saMsTAnaM, upasTAnaM, aByAsatvaM; ‘in the neighborhood of the house,’ gfhasanniDAne, gfhopAnte. — (Inhabitants of the neighborhood) samIpavAsinaH m. pl., nikawavAsinaH m. pl., sAmantavAsinaH m. pl., prati- vAsinaH m. pl., samIpalokAH m. pl., tatratyalokAH m. pl.

Neighbour, s. prativeSin m., prativeSaH-SyaH, prativAsin m. prAtiveSikaH, nikawa or samIpa-sTaH-vartin m., vAsin m., sAmaMtaH; ‘next door n(eighbour)’ prAtiveSyaH, anaMtaravAsI. a. prativAsin, samIpasTa, &c. v. t. nikawe sTA 1 P or vft 1 A or vas 1 P; See Border. [Neighbour]hood, s. saMniDiH, upakaMWaH, sAMniDyaM, sAmIpyaM, saMni-karzaH, upAMtaH-taM, nEkawyaM, aByAsaH. 2 samIpa-saMnihita-deSaH, sAmaMtaM, prativeSaH, aDivAsaH. 3 samIpa-nikawa-vAsinaH, prAtiveSyAH, prativAsinaH, (pl.). [Neighbour]ing, a. samIpa-nikawa-vartin, samIpa-nikawa-sTa, sAmaMta, saMnihita, upAMta, Asanna; See Near. [Neighbour]ly, a. prativAsayogya; upakAraSIla, hita.

NEIGHBOUR (subs.): (1) prativeSin (f. nI), the n.s: prativeSivargaH, Mr. iii.; n. ing house- holder: prativeSikagfhapatiH, Mr. vi.;(2) prati- vAsin (f. nI);(3) prAtiveSya (f. SyA) (rare), n.ing fortune-teller: prAtiveSyaH kArtAntikaH, D. ii.
NEIGHBOURHOOD: sannihitapradeSaH. Ph.: “in the n. of death”: mftyusanniDO, “law of n.”: prativeSi- DarmaH; in the n. of Mithilā: miTilopakaRWe, Vi. iv.
NEIGHBOURING (adj.): I Of men: v. Neigh- -bour.II Of places, etc.: nikawavartin (f. nI): v. Near, adjoining.
NEIGHBOURLY (adj.): by comp., n. dealing: prativeSivyavahAraH.
NEIGHING , s. hezA, hrezA, hrezitaM, hlezA, rezaRaM -zitaM, hrezitasvanaH, aSvaSabdaH, aSvanAdaH, aSvanisvanaH.

sanskrit.slp1: na ca liNgaM na ca vayaH
sanskrit.word: न च लिङ्गं न च वयः
sanskrit.iast: na ca liṅgaṃ na ca vayaḥ

sanskrit.slp1: na ca na paricito na cApyagamyaH
sanskrit.word: न च न परिचितो न चाप्यगम्यः
sanskrit.iast: na ca na paricito na cāpyagamyaḥ

details.body: Neither, (nor), a., conj. na-na va, na ca-na ca, (na ca na paricito na cApyagamyaH M. 1), or simply na-na, (mA-mA, with Imperative). 2 eka, ekatara, anyatara with na, or by uBO.

NEITHER (conj.): (1) na..na vA, only nine cate- gories n. more nor less: navEva dravyARi nADikAni na nyUnAni vA, V. d.;(2) na ca..na ca n. sex nor age: na ca liNgaM na ca vayaH, U.;(3) na..na, n. very high nor very low: nAtyucCritaM nAtinIcam, G.;(4) na..na ca, nor father n. brothers: na pitA na ca BrAtaraH, Kat.;(5) na ca..nApi, S.

NEITHER (pron.): (1) expr. with: ekaH (kA, kaM), api or ekataraH (rA, raM) and na, “both, one, or n.”: upayamekaM nEkataraM vA; you can enjoy n.: na tvayekamapi BoktuM Sakyam;(2) with uBa (= both) and na.

NEITHER , pron. (Not either, not the one or the other) expressed by anyataraH -rA -raM or ekataraH -rA -raM or uBO, or simply by the dual in conjunction with the negative na; as, ‘neither of them can break the bow,’ Danur BaMktum ekataro na Saknoti or uBO na SaknutaH or simply na SaknutaH.

NEITHER , conj. expressed by the negative na or na ca, or by the prohibitive mA. Sometimes in conjunction with vA; as, ‘he took neither food nor clothes for his journey,’ yAtrArTaM BakzyaM vastraM vA na jagrAha; ‘take neither food nor clothes,’ BakzyaM vastraM vA mA gfhARa; ‘do not eat the fruit neither touch it,’ PalaM mA KAdata mA spfSata; ‘he did not touch, neither did he smell,’ nAspfSad na cAjiGrat.
NEM . CON. sarvvasammatyA, sarvvAnumatyA, sarvvasvIkAreRa.
NEOGAMIC: navakftaparigrahaH: v. To marry, newly.
Neogamist, s. navoQaH-QA, navaBAryA, navapatiH.
NEOGAMIST , s. navoQaH -QA, navavaDUH f., navaBAryyA f., navapatiH m.
NEOLOGIC , NEOLOGICAL, a. (Pertaining to neology) nUtananyAyasambanDI -nDinI &c., nUtanamatasambanDI &c. — (Employing new words, &c.) See the next.
NEOLOGIST , s. nUtanaSabdasevI m. (n), nUtananyAyASrayI m., nUtanamatASrayI m., nUtananyAyasevI m.
Neology, s. nUtananyAyaH-mataM. 2 nUtanaSabdASrayaH. [Neolog]ist, s. nUtanamatASrayin m. nUtananyAyasevin m.
NEOLOGY: I Lit.: navaSabdavyavahAraH and sim. comp.s.II In theology: navamatam and sim. comp.s.
NEOLOGY , s. nUtananyAyaH, nUtanamataM, nUtanavidyA. — (Employment of new words, &c.) nUtanaSabdasezanaM, nUtanamatASrayaRaM.
Neophyte, s. navaSizyaH-CAtraH, anaByastaH, prATamakalpikaH, aparicitaH.
NEOPHYTE: navaSizya (f. zyA): v. Novice, newly convert.
NEOPHYTE , s. navaCAtraH, navaSizyaH, prATamakalpikaH, nUtanaSizyaH.
NEOPLASTIC: navodBUtaH (tA, taM) and sim. comp.s.
NEOPLATONISM: *navaplAwunadarSanam or -matam.
NEOTERIC: nUtanaH (nA, naM): v. New.
NEOTERIC , a. nUtanaH -nA -naM, navaH -vA -vaM, nazInaH -nA -naM, idAnIntanaH -nI -naM, AGunikaH -kI -kaM, arvAcInaH -nA -naM.
NEPAL , s. (The country) nepAlaH. — (Belonging to it, or pro- duced in it) nEpAlikaH -kI -kaM, nEpAlaH -lI -laM.
Nepenthe, s. duHKaSamanaM.
NEPENTHE, -s: *duHKaharamOzaDam; santApaSamanam.
NEPENTHE , s. duHKaSamanaM, duHKahArakam OzaDaM, upaSamanaM.
Nephew, s. BrAtrIyaH, BrAtfvyaH-jaH, BrAtfpatraH-sutaH. 2 (Sisterʼs son) BAgineyaH, svastrIyaH, BaginI or svasf-putraH or sutaH.
NEPHEW: I A brother's son:(1) BrAtrIyaH; (2) BrAtfvyaH;(3) BrAtuzputraH.II A sister's son: (1) BAgineyaH;(2) svasrIyaH;(3) BaginIsutaH, P.
NEPHEW , s. (Brother's son) BrAtfjaH, BrAtrIyaH, BrAtfputraH, BrAtfsutaH, BrAtfvyaH. — (Sister's son) BAgineyaH, svasrIyaH, BaginIputraH, svasfputraH, BaginIsutaH, svasfsutaH.
Nephritic, [Nephritic]al, a. vfkkasaMbaMDin. 2 vfkkarogahara.
NEPHRITIC, -AL: Ph.: n. disease: bukkArogaH, n. patient: bukkArogin (f. RI).

NEPHRITIC , NEPHRITICAL, a. (Relating to the kidneys) mUtrapiRqa- sambanDI -nDinI &c., bfkkasambanDI &c. — (Relieving disease of the kidneys) mUtrapiRqarogahArI -riRI &c., mUtraroganASakaH -kA -kaM, bfkkarogaGnaH -GnI -GnaM.
Nepotism, s. jYAtyatisnehaH, kulapakzapAtaH.
NEPOTISM: *nABibanDaH; or by circumlo.
NEPOTISM , s. (Fondness for nephews) BrAtfvyaBAgineyasnehaH. — (Un- due attachment for relations) putrapOtrAdipakzapAtaH, kulapakzatA, apatyAtisnehaH, santAnAtisnehaH, bAnDavAtisnehaH.
Nereid, s. jala-samudra-devatA.
NEREID: jaladevatA and sim. comps.
NEREID , s. (Sea-nymph) samudrIyadevI, sAmudradevI, jaladevI.

Nerve, s. SirA, vasnasA, snasA; Damani-nI f., majjA-jYAna-taMtuH. 2 balaM, vIryaM, tejas-ojas n., SarIradfQatA. 3 DEryaM, Dfti f., manaHsTEryaM. v. t. balaM-DEryaM dA 3 U or vfD c. [Nerve]less, a. nirbala, durbala, SaktihIna. [Nerv]ous, a. SirAla; majjAtaMtugata. 2 ojasvin, sabala, vIryavat, Urjasvala, sudfQa, DIra. 3 kziprakzoBa, kaMpa-vepana-SIla, DEryahIna. [Nerv]ously, adv. savIryaM, sabalaM. 2 sakaMpaM, DEryaM vinA. [Nerv]ousness, s. vIryaM, ojas n. Urjas n. balaM. 2 snAyuvikAraH, kaMpaSIlatA, aDftiH.
NERVE: I Organ of sensation: SirAH v. Also sinew.II Strength, vigour: q. v.: GEryam.

NERVE , s. (Organ of sensation, connected with the marrow of the brain and spine) majjAtantuH m., jYAnatantuH, jYAnavAhinI, cEtanyavAhinI, cEtanyatantuH m., SirA, sirA. — (Sinew, tendon) srAyuH m., srasA, SirA, sirA, DamaniH -nI f., nAqiH -qI f., vahIruH m., rasAlasA, sanDibanDanaM. — (Strength of body) SarIradfQatA, SarIra- dArQyaM, gAtradArQyaM, SarIrabalaM, tejas n., vIryyaM, ojas n., UrjaH. — (Strength of mind) DEryyaM, DIratA -tvaM, DftiH f., manaHsTEryyaM, budDivEBavaM.
To NERVE , v. a. balaM or DEryyaM dA or vfD (c. 10. varDayati -yituM), sabalIkf.
NERVELESS , a. nirbalaH -lA -laM, durbalaH -lA -laM, balahInaH -nA -naM.
NERVOUS: I Lit.: SirAlaH (lA, laM).II Vi- -gorous: q. v.III Easily agitated: sahaja- cakitaH (tA, taM) (?).

NERVOUS , a. (Pertaining to the nerves) majjAtantusambanDI -nDinI &c., majjAtantusTaH -sTA -sTaM, majjAtantugataH -tA -taM. — (Having the nerves affected, easily agitated) majjAtanturogI -giRI &c., majjAtantuvikArI &c., SirArogI &c., DEryyahInaH -nA -naM, kampaSIlaH -lA -laM, vepanaSIlaH &c. — (Vigorous) vIryyavAn -vatI -vat (t), tejovAn &c., ojasvI &c., UrjasvAn &c., UrjasvalaH -lA -laM, DIraH -rA -raM, dfQaH -QA -QaM, sudfQaH &c.
NERVOUSLY , adv. (With vigor) savIryyaM, saDEryyaM, sabalaM, DEryyeRa. — (With weakness) DEryyeRa vinA, DEryyaM vinA, sakampaM, savepanaM, kampa- SIlatvAt.
NERVOUSNESS: I Vigour, strength, as of style: ojas (n.), K.II. Weakness of ner- -ves: sahajacakitatA (?).

NERVOUSNESS , s. (Vigor) vIryyaM, DEryyaM, DIratA -tvaM, tejas n., ojas n., dArQyaM, dfQatA, sudfQatA, UrjaH. — (Affection or weakness of the nerves, agitation) majjAtanturogaH, majjAtantuvikAraH -ritA, DEryyahInatA, aDftiH f., kampaSIlatA, vepanaSIlatA.
NESCIENCE , s. ajYAnaM -natA, jYAnABAvaH, jYAnahInatA, aboDaH, ajYatA.

NESS . This termination, denoting state or quality, is ex- pressed in Sanskrit by the affixes tA, tvaM, and yaM, the last usually requiring Vriddhi of the first syllable of the noun; as, from ‘idle,’ alasa; ‘idleness,’ alasatA, alasatvaM, AlasyaM.

Nest, s. nIqaH-qaH, kulAyaH, nilayaH, pakzisTAnaM-gfhaM. 2 gfhaM, sTAnaM, ADAraH, ASayaH; ‘find a mareʼs n(est)’ SaSavizARaM Asad c. or laB 1 A. Nestle, v. i. (pakzivat) nIqaM ASri 1 U or aDi-SI 2 A, suKena SI or saMviS 6 P or ni-lI 4 A. v. t. puz 1, 4, 9 P or c. pA c. (pAlayati). [Nestl]ing, s. nIqasTaH pakziSAvaH.
NEST: I Lit.:(1) nIqaH, to build a n.: nIqaM nirmimIte, H. or viracayati, K.;(2) kulAyaH, n.- trees: kulAyadrumAH, U. ii. 9. Ph.: to find a mare's n.: SaSavizARam aDigacCati.II Retreat, abode: q. v.

NEST , s. (Of birds) nIqaH -qaM, kulAyaH, pakzisTAnaM, pakzigfhaM, KagasTAnaM, jAlakaM, aNkurakaH. — (Any abode, receptacle) gfhaM, sTAnaM, niDiH m., niDAnaM, ASayaH, ASrayaH; ‘sitting in a nest,’ kulAyanilAyaH.
NESTLE: lIyate, ni-, (lI, c. 4), n.ing place.: nilayaH

To NESTLE , v. n. pakzivat svanIqam ASri (c. 1. -Srayati -yituM) or samASri or saMSri, suKena or suKam ASri, yaTAsuKam ASri or SI (c. 2. Sete, SayituM) or aDiSI or saMviS (c. 6. -viSati -vezwuM) or upaviS or nilI (c. 4. -lIyate -letuM).
To NESTLE , v. a. (Cherish) pAl (c. 10. pAlayati -yituM), puz (c. 10. pozayati -yituM),
NESTLING (subs.): (nIqasTaH) pakziSAvaH, -kaH.
NESTLING , s. kulAyasTaH or nIqasTaH pakziSAvakaH, kulAyasTAyI m. (n).
NESTOR: in fig. sense: perh. muKyaH (chief.).
NESTOR , s. (Sage old man) vfhaspatiH m.

Net, s. jAlaM, pASaH, baMDanaM-nI, pASabaMDaH, vi-(vI)taMsaH; ‘n(et) for deer’ vAgurA, mfgabaMDanI, mfgajAlaM; ‘n(et) for fish’ AnAyaH, jAlaM; ‘n(et)work’ jAla-sUtra-karman n. 2 kUwayaMtraM, unmATaH. a. SudDa, aSeza, nirudDAra, aBagna, aKaMqa, anyUna. v. t. jAle baMD 9 P or grah 9 U. 2 jAlIkf 8 U.
NET (subs.): jAlam, to spread a n.: jAlaM vinastA- [Page471] rayati, H.; I may use some n. by means of it: taddvAreRa kiYcijjAlamAcareyam, D. iii.: v. Snare.
NET (v.): I To make network: jAlaM karoti. II To catch with a n.: jAlena baDnAti, n.ed: pASabadDAH, H.III. To make clear gain: expr. by adj.
NET (adj.): SudDa (f. dDA): v. Pure.

NET , s. jAlaM, jAlakaM, AnAyaH, pASaH, pASabanDaH -nDaM, vAgurA, unmATaH, kUwaH, kUwayantraM, vItaMsaH, vitaMsaH, pakzibanDanaM, banDanaM -nI; ‘for deer,’ mfgabanDinI -naM, pAtilI; ‘for fish,’ matsyaDAnI, matsyajAlaM, matsya- grahaRI, matsyagrahaRArTaM jAlaM, kupinI, paYjarAKewaH; ‘maker of nets,’ jAlakArakaH.
NET , a. (Clear, free from deductions) aSezaH -zA -zaM, niravaSezaH &c., aBagnaH -gnA -gnaM, asvaRqaH -RqA -RqaM, anyUnaH -nA -naM, nirudDAraH -rA -raM, SudDaH -dDA -dDaM.
To NET , v. a. (Make clear gain) anyUnaM PalaM laB (c. 1. laBate, labDuM).
Nether, a. aDas in comp.; aDara, avara, aDaHsTa, aDoBava, aDastana (nI f.); ‘n(ether) world’ aDolokaH; ‘n(ether) garment’ aDo-vAsaH. [Nether]most, a. avaratama.
NETHER: aDas, n. world: aDoBuvanam: v. Lower.

NETHER , a. aDaraH -rA -raM, avaraH -rA -raM, aDarasTaH -sTA -sTaM, aDaHsTaH &c., aDoBavaH -vA -vaM, aDastanaH -nI -naM, nIcasTaH &c., aDamaH -mA -maM, avamaH &c., jaGanyaH -nyA -nyaM; ‘nether part,’ aDoBAgaH; ‘nether world,’ aDolokaH; ‘nether garment,’ aGoMSukaM, anta- rIyaM; ‘nether sky,’ naBastalaM.
NETHERMOST: n. hell: nitalam (?), V. p.
NETHERMOST , a. avaraH -rA -raM, avaratamaH -mA -maM, aDaratamaH &c., nIcatamaH &c.
NETTING , NET-WORK, s. jAlaM -lakaM, jAlakarmma n. (n), jAlaprAyA.
Nettle, s. pItaparRI. v. t. saM-pari-tap c., prakup c., ruz c.; See Enrage, Excite.
NETTLE: I Subs.: a plant: pItaparRI.II Verbs: kzomayati (c. of kzuB): v. To irri- -tate, vex.
NETTLE , s. (A plant) pItaparRI.
To NETTLE , v. a. prakup (c. 10. -kopayati -yituM), vyaT (c. 10. vyaTayati -yituM), santap (c. 10. -tApayati -yituM), kopaM jan (c. 10. janayati -yituM).
NETTLED , p. p. IzatkupitaH -tA -taM, IzatsantaptaH -ptA -ptaM, vyaTitaH -tA -taM.
NETWORK: jAlakarman (n.); sUtrakarman (n.).
Neural, a. vasnasA-SirA-saMbaMDin [Neural]gia, s. vAtaSUlaM.
NEURALGIA: *SirASUlam.
NEURALGIA , s. majjAtantuvedanA, majjAtantuvyaTA, SirAvedanA.
Neurology, s. SirAvarRanaM.
NEUROLOGY , s. majjAtantuvarRanaM -nA, majjAtantuvidyA, SirAvarRanaM.
Neurotomy, s. SirAcCedavidyA.
NEUROTOMY , s. majjAtantuCedaH -danaM, SirAvyavaCedavidyA.

Neuter, a. napuMsaka, klIba, tftIya(yA)-prakfti, zaMQa; ‘n(euter) gender’ klIbaM, napuMsakaM; See below. Neutral, a. maDyasTa, tawasTa, udAsIna, apakzapAtin, samadfzwi, samaBAva, uBayasAmAnya, apakzapAta; See Indifferent. s. tawasTaH, uBayasAmAnyaH. [Neutral]ity, s. mADyasTyaM, tAwasTyaM, apakzapAtaH, OdAsInyaM, uBayasAmyaM, samaBAvaH, samadfzwi f. [Neutral]ly, adv. OdAsInye-na, uBayasAmAnyaM, samaBAvena. Neutralize, v. t. viSizwa-guRAn naS c., durbalIkf 8 U, balaM-SaktiM-naS c. 2 udAsInIkf. [Neutraliz]ation, s. viSizwaguRanASaH-SanaM, viSezaDarmalopaH, durbalIkaraRaM. 2 udAsInIkaraRaM. [Neutraliz]ed, a. nazwa-guRa-Sakti-bala.

NEUTER: n. gender: klIvaliNgam; words expressing species of fruit are n.: PalajAtivAcI Sabdo napuMsakaM syAt, S. k.; (words) having these terminations are n.: etadantAni klIvAni, S. k.; a n. verb: akarmakakriyA; (the verb) mA in (the sense of) mea- suring is n.: mA mAne akarmakaH, S. k.

NEUTER , NEUTRAL, a. (Not adhering to either party, indifferent) apakzapAtI -tinI -ti (n), vipakzapAtaH -tA -taM, uBayapakzasamAnaH -nA -naM, uBayapakzasamaH -mA -maM, uBayasAmAnyaH -nyA -nyaM, uBayasADAraRaH -RI -RaM, uBayapakzaBinnaH -nnA -nnaM, udAsInaH -nA -naM, udAsI &c., tawasTaH -sTA -sTaM, maDyasTaH &c., samadarSI &c., samadfzwiH -zwiH -zwi, samabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, samaBAvaH -vA -vaM, samaH -mA -maM. — (Neuter gender) klIvaH -vaM, napuMsakaH -kaM, napuMsakaliNgaM, tftIyaprakftiH f., tftIyAprakftiH.
NEUTRAL: (1) maDyasTa (f. sTA), but others rema- ined n.: maDyasTAstvapare'mavan, Mah. ii. 45. 32.; (2) maDyamaH (mA, maM) (rare), R. xiii. 7.: v. Indifferent.
NEUTRALITY: mADyasTyam, to betake n.: mADyasTyamava- lambate.

NEUTRALITY , s. mADyasTaM -sTyaM, maDyasTatA -tvaM, tAwasTyaM, tawasTatA -tvaM, uBayapakzasamatA, apakzapAtaH -titA, vipakzapAtatvaM, udAsInatA, OdA- sInyaM, OdAsyaM, uBayasamatA, uBayasAmyaM, uBayasAmAnyaM, uBayasADAraRyaM, samadfzwiH f., samatA, sAmyaM, saBAnatA.

NEUTRALIZATION , s. (Act of destroying the peculiar properties of a body) viSezaguRanASaH -SanaM, viSezaDarmmanASaH -SanaM, guRavinASanaM, viSezaguRapratIkAraH. — (Act of reducing to a state of neutrality) udAsInIkaraRaM, samIkaraRaM, uBayasamIkaraRaM. — (Rendering ineffi- cient) nirbalIkaraRaM, durbalIkaraRaM.
NEUTRALIZE: nASayati (c. of naS) (= to des- -troy.).

To NEUTRALIZE , v. a. (Destroy the peculiar properties of) vi- SezaguRAn naS (c. 10. nASayati -yituM), viSezaguRanASanaM kf, viSezaDarmma- nASaM kf. — (Render neutral) udAsInIkaraRaM, uBayasamIkaraRaM. — (Render inefficient) nirbalIkf, durbalIkf, balaM naS.
NEUTRALIZED , p. p. nazwaguRaH -RA -RaM, nazwabalaH -lA -laM, nazwaSaktiH -ktiH -kti.
NEUTRALIZER , s. viSezaguRanASakaH, balanASakaH, SaktinASakaH, guRaGnaH.
NEUTRALLY , adv. udAsInavat, OdAsInyapUrvvaM, uBayasAmyena, samadfzwyA.

sanskrit.slp1: na jAtu nirvftiM bAlA laBate sma
sanskrit.word: न जातु निर्वृतिं बाला लभते स्म
sanskrit.iast: na jātu nirvṛtiṃ bālā labhate sma

details.body: Never, adv. na kadAcit, na kadApi, na kadAcana, na jAtu, na karhicit; ‘n(ever)-fading’ ajara; ‘n(ever)-failing’ amoGa, akzayya; ‘n(ever)-more’ na BUyaH, netaHparaM, na punaH.

NEVER: (1) na kadAcit -api, na kadApi, or na kadA- cana, will n. admit in the presence of Rākṣasa: na kadAcidapi rAkzasasyAgrataH pratipatsyate, Mu.; n. grieve: KedaM kadApi mA kfTAH, Bham.;(2) na jAtu, the girl n. felt easy: na jAtu nirvftiM bAlA laBate sma, Ku.;(3) Often by sim. na, such a horse n. was and n. will be: nEvaMviDo BUto BAvI vA turaNgamaH, K.; n. to open again: apunarUnmIlanAya, C.; n. -fad- ing: ajaraH (rA, raM), H.; n. -failing: akzayya (f. yyA), D. N. so (= ever so) expr. by yAvat: v. Much as, as. N. more: itaH paraM . na.

NEVER , adv. na kadAcit, na kadApi, na kadAcana, na karhicit, na jAtu, na jAtucit, sometimes expressed by na; as, ‘there never has been and never will be any one like him,’ anena sadfSaH kaScin na BUto na Bavizyati.
Nevertheless, conj. taTApi, kiMtu, punaH, paraMtu, paraM.
NEVERTHELESS: (1) taTApi: v. Yet;(2) kintu (= but: q. v.).
NEVERTHELESS , conj. taTApi, punar, parantu, paraM, kintu, apitu, kiYca.

New, a. nava, navIna, aBinava, nUtana, pratyagra (of flowers &c.). 2 ADunika (kI f.), idAnIMtana-aDunAtana- (nI f.), arvAcIna. 3 apUrva aBUta-adfzwa-pUrva, aSrutapUrva. 4 anaByasta, aparicita, avijYAnin; ‘n(ew)-comer’ AgaMtukaH, navAgataH; ‘n(ew)-born’ navotpanna, sadyojAta; ‘n(ew)-fangled’, ‘n(ew)-fashioned’ navaGawita, navakalpita-sfzwa; ‘n(ew) yearʼs day’ varzapratipad f. [New]ly, adv. navaM, pratyagraM, sadyaH, nUtanaM, nava in comp.; ‘n(ewly) married wife’ navoQA, navapARigrahaRA vaDUH; ‘n(ewly) ripe (blown)’ pratyagravikasita. [New]ness, s. navInatA, apUrvatA. 2 nUtanArItiH, navAcAraH.

NEW: (1) navaH (vA, vraM), a n. lord: naveSvaraH, R.; a n. descent of man: navaH purUzAvatAraH, U.; the n. moon: navo niSAkaraH, Sa.; n. crops: navaSasyAni, H.;(2) navInaH (nA, naM), a n. shoot: navIno'NkuraH, Pri.;(3) aBinavaH (vA, vaM), a n. servant: aBinavasevakaH, K.; a n. work: aBinavA kftiH, Vi.;(4) nUtanaH (nA, naM), n. cloud: nUtanaGanaH, Vi.;(5) navyaH (vyA, vyaM), n. offering: navyaM havyam, B.r.;(6) nUtnaH (tnA, tnaM) (rare);(7) apUrvaH (rvA, rvaM) (= unprecedented). New-year's day: navavarzasya praTamadivasaH.

NEW , a. navaH -vA -vaM, navInaH -nA -naM, nUtanaH -nA -naM, nUtnaH -tnA -tnaM, navyaH -vyA -vyaM, aBinavaH -vA -vaM, pratinavaH -vA -vaM, pratyagraH -grA -graM, taruRaH -RA -RaM. — (Modern, not ancient) ADunikaH -kI -kaM, idA- nIntanaH -nI -naM, aDunAtanaH -nI -naM, sadyaskAlInaH -nA -naM, aprAcInaH -nA -naM, apurAtanaH -nI -naM. — (Never occurring before) aBUtapUrvvaH -rvvA -rvvaM, adfzwapUrvvaH &c., aSrutapUrvvaH &c., apUrvvaH &c., ayaTApUrvvaH &c. — (Not habituated, not familiar) anaByastaH -stA -staM, aparicitaH -tA -taM. — (Not before used) aprayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, anupaBuktaH &c.; ‘new moon. See MOON.
NEW-BORN , a. sadyojAtaH -tA -taM, jAtamAtraH -trI -traM, navotpannaH -nnA -nnaM.
NEW-COMER , s. AgantukaH, AgantuH m., navAgataH, navAByAgataH.
NEW-FANGLED: navakalpitaH (tA, taM) and sim. comp.s.
NEW-FANGLED , a. navakalpitaH -tA -taM, navasfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, nUtanaH -nA -naM.
NEW-FASHIONED: navaGawitaH (tA, taM) (?); navaH (vA, vaM): v. New.
NEW-TESTAMENT , s. navInaniyamaH, nUtananiyamaH, navaniyamaH.
NEW-YEAR'S DAY , s. varzapratipad f., vatsarapratipad, saMvatsarapratipad.
NEWCOMER: (1) AgantukaH, as we are n.s: AgantukatayA, Sa. vi.;(2) navAgataH and sim. comp.s., the n. Chandrāpiḍa: aBinavAgataScandrA- pIqaH, K.
NEWLY: n. -married wife: navapARigrahaRA vaDUH, R. or aciroQA, Si.; n. -blown: navavinidraH (drA, draM), Ki.: v. New, recently.
NEWLY , adv. navaM, nUtanaM, navInaM, aBinavaM, pratinavaM, pratyagraM, sadyas.
NEWNESS: (1) navInatA: v. Novelty.
NEWNESS , s. navatA -tvaM, navInatA, nUtanatA -tvaM, navyatA, nAvyaM, aBinavatA, pratinavatA, pratyagratA. — (State of not being known before) apUrvvatA -tvaM, aBUtapUrvvatA.

News, s. vArtA, vfttAMtaH, pravftti f., udaMtaH, samAcAraH, vfttaM. 2 saMvAdaH, janavAdaH-Sruti f., lokapravAMdaH, kiMvadaMtI; ‘good n(ews)’ BadraM, SuBaM, SuBavArtA; ‘ill n(ews)’ aSuBaM, aSuBa-vArtA; ‘ill n(ews) travels fast’ aSuBavArtA satvaraM bahulIBavati; ‘n(ews)-monger’ vArtA-vfttiH, vArtAyanaH, vArtAvahanavfttiH, ‘n(ews)-paper’ vArtA-samAcAra-patraM, vfttapatraM.

NEWS: (1) vArttA, distressed on hearing the n.: viditavArttAvArttO, D. i.; without (any) n.: vArttayA vinA; K.;(2) vfttAntaH, what n. of your friend: ko vfttAntaste saKyAH, Mal. iv.; is there any n.: asti navInaH ko'pi vfttAntaH, Pri. i.;(3) pravfttiH, receiving our n. from the son of Wind: prAmaYjane- rasmatpravfttimupalamya, Vi.; was the conveyer of bad n.: duzpravfttiharA'Bavat, R. xii. 51. Ph.: good n.: Badram, SuBam, etc.; bad n.: aSuBam, etc.; pleasant n.: priyam, Sa.; this is no n. to me: neyaM navA vArttA.

NEWS , s. vArttA, vfttAntaH, samAcAraH, sandeSaH, sandizwaM, saMvAdaH, vfttaM, varttamAnaM, pravfttiH f., kiMvadantI, udantaH -ntakaH, lokavAdaH, lokapravAdaH, janavAdaH, janaSrutiH f., vAcikaM, sUcanA; ‘What's the news?’ kA vArttA; ‘good news,’ suvArttA, SuBavArttA, SuBavfttAntaH; ‘bad news,’ durvArttA, anizwavArttA, aSuBavArttA.
NEWS-VENDER (-DOR): *saMvAdapatravikretf (f. trI); -vikrayin (f. RI).
NEWS-VENDER , s. samAcArapatravikretA m. (tf), vArttApatravikrayI m.
NEWSMONGER: vArttAyanaH, vArttApracArakaH.; etc.
NEWSMONGER , s. vArttAyanaH, vArttAvfttiH m., samAcAravfttiH m., vArttAvya- vasAyI m. (n), vArttAvahanavyApArI m., vArttikaH, kuSIlavaH, samAcA- ravyavasAyI.
NEWSPAPER: saMvAdapatrikA, Weekly n.: sAptA- hikapatrikA.
NEWSPAPER , s. samAcArapatraM, vArttApatraM, vAcikapatraM, saMvAdapatraM.
Newt, s. kzudragoDA.
NEWT: tfRagoDA, -DikA: v. Lizard.
NEWT , s. tfRagoDA -DikA, sUkzmagoDA -DikA, kzudragoDA.

Next, a. (Of time) AgAmin; ‘on Monday n(ext)’ AgAmini somavAsare. 2 anaMtara, avyavahita, avyavaDAna, saMsakta, niraMtarAla; ‘n(ext) to the skin’ SarIrasaMsakta. 3 sannihita; pArSvasTa, aMtika, samIpa or nikawa-sTa or vartin; See Near; oft. ex. by para, anya, aMtaraM in comp.; ‘n(ext) born’ anaMtara-ja ‘in the absence of the first, the n(ext) and so on’ pUrvABAve paraH paraH; ‘on the n(ext) day’ parAhe, paredyuH; ‘the n(ext) world’ paralokaH, lokAMtaraM; ‘n(ext) door to’ adUra, IzadUna (with abl.); kalpa in comp.; ‘in the n(ext) world’ amutra, paratra; ‘n(ext) moment’ kzaRAMtaraM; ‘n(ext) but one’ ekAMtaraM. adv. anaMtaraM, paraM, parataH (with abl.); tataH, tadanaMtaraM, aTa, parastAt, tataH-paraM-UrDvaM; ‘what n(ext)’ tataH kiM, tatastataH.

NEXT (adj.): (1) paraH (rA, raM), the n. day: paredyuH; in absence of the first, n and n.: pUrvABAve paraH paraH, Y. ii. 135.;(2) AgAmin (f. nI) (= coming: of time), on the n. 14th (lunar) night: AgAminyAM caturdaSIkzapAyAm, C.;(3) anantaraH [Page472] (rA, raM) (= without any interval: rare), n. -born: anantaraja (f. jA), R. vii. 32.; in the n. continent: anantare varze, K.
NEXT (adj.): I Of place:(1) anantaram;(2) by adj.II Of time, succession, etc.: param, parataH or pareRa, n. to a daughter's son: dOhitrAtparataH, Da. Ph.: what n.: tataH kim: v. Then.

NEXT , a. (In time, &c.) anantaraH -rA -raM, nirantaraH -rA -raM. — (Next in place, having nothing intervening) avyavaDAnaH -nA -naM, avyavahitaH -tA -taM, anantarAlaH -lA -laM, nirantarAlaH -lA -laM, apa- dAntaraH -rA -raM, sannihitaH -tA -taM, pArSvasTaH -sTA -sTaM, antikaH -kA -kaM, antimaH -mA -maM. Next in time may also be expressed by paraH -rA -raM or antaraM; as, ‘the next day,’ paradivasaH, parAhaH; ‘the next world,’ paralokaH -kaM, lokAntaraM; ‘in the next world,’ paratra, pretya, amutra; ‘relating to the next world,’ pAratrikaH -kI -kaM, amutratyaH -tyA -tyaM, AmuzmikaH -kI -kaM; ‘the next moment,’ kzaRAntaraM; ‘next born,’ anantarajaH -jA -jaM; ‘next of kin,’ anantaraH -rA -raM; ‘next but one,’ ekAntaraH -rA -raM; ‘next but two,’ dvyantaraH -rA -raM, dvyekAntaraH -rA -raM.
NEXT , adv. anantaraM, tadanantaraM, pratyanantaraM, paraM -reRa, paratas, parastAt, tataH paraM, ataH paraM, ata UrdDvaM; ‘next day,’ paradivase, paredyus; ‘next moment,’ kzaRAntare.
Nexus, s. baMDaH, sAMDiH.
Nib, s. caMcu f., tuMqaM. 2 agraM, aRi f., agra-BAgaH. [Nib]bed, a. sAgra, aRimat.
NIB (Subs.): I Of a bird: caYcuH.II Of a pen: kalamAgram (??).
NIB (v.): tIkzRIkaroti (= to sharpen) (??).
NIB , s. (Bill, beak) caYcuH f., tuRqaH -RqiH m., muKaH. — (Point) agraM, aRiH m., agraBAgaH; ‘of a pen,’ kalamAgraM.
NIBBED , a. aRimAn -matI -mat (t), agravAn -vatI &c., sAgraH -grA -graM.
Nibble, v. t. (alpAlpaM) daMS 1 P, avakft 6 P, carv 1 P, 10; kramaSaH-alpAlpaSaH-KAd 1 P or kft or Bakz 10. 2 CidraM anviz 4 P, dozaM grah 9 U, asUyati (D.) (with dat.).
NIBBLE: I To bite: daSati (daMS, c. 1.).II To carp: q. v.

To NIBBLE , v. a. and n. alpAlpaSaH or alpAlpaM carv (c. 1. carvati -rvituM, c. 10. carvayati -yituM) or daMS (c. 1. daSati, daMzwuM) or vidaMS or sandaMS, sammuKadantEr alpAlpaM KAd (c. 1. KAdati -dituM) or Cid (c. 7. Cinatti, CettuM), kramaSaH KAd or Bakz (c. 10. Bakzayati -yituM) or carvaRaM kf. — (Carp at) dozM or Cidram anviz (c. 4. -izyati -ezituM) or grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM), CidrAnvezaM kf, asUya (nom. asUyati).
NIBBLED , p. p. alpAlpaSaH KAditaH -tA -taM or carvitaH -tA -taM or dazwaH -zwA -zwaM, sammuKadantEr jagDaH -gDA -gDaM or CinnaH -nnA -nnaM or lUnaH -nA -naM.

Nice, a. lalita, SoBana, su in comp., suBaga, ramya, ramaRIya, rucira, manohara, sADu. 2 svAdu, surasa, mizwa, AsvAdavat, rucira, rucikara. 3 sUkzmadfzwi-darSin, kuSAgrabudDi. 4 sUkzma, ati-sUkzma, supariSudDa, samyac. 5 asTUla, sUkzma, virala (cloth). 6 komala, mfdu, pelava, sukumAra. 7 atisUkzma, atinipuRa. [Nice]ly, adv. suzWu, su pr., lalitaM, SoBanaM, samyak. 2 sUkzmaM, sUkzmatvena. [Nice]ness, [Nice]ty, s. lAlityaM, ramyatA, svAdutA, sOrasyaM; sUkzmadfzwi f., sUkzma-darSitA, kuSAgramatitvaM, sUkzmatA; yukti f., nIti f.

NICE: I Delicate, dainty:(1) lalitaH (tA, taM);(2) svAdu (mfn.) (= sweet).II Agreeable, delightful: rUciraH (rA, raM).III Delicate, refined: sUkzama (f. kzmA).IV Exact, accurate: viSudDa (f. dDA). V. Fasti- -dious, scrupulous: sUkzmapriyaH (yA, yaM) (??).

NICE , a. (Delicious, pleasant to the taste) svAduH -duH -dvI -du, surasaH -sA -saM, mizwaH -zwA -zwaM, suKAsvAdaH -dA -daM, ruciraH -rA -raM, rucikaH -kA -kaM, rucyaH -cyA -cyaM, rUcikaraH -rA -raM. — (Exact, accurate) sUkzmaH -kzmA -kzmaM, aYjasaH -sA -saM, samaYjasaH -sA -saM, samyaN -mIcI -myak (k), SudDaH -dDA -dDaM. — (Judging with exactness or minuteness) sUkzmadfzwiH -zwiH -zwi, sUkzmadarSI -rSinI -rSi (n), kuSAgradfzwiH &c., kuSA- grIyamatiH -tiH -ti, kuSAgrIyabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, kuSAgrabudDiH &c. — (Over-exact) atisUkzmaH &c., atisUkzmadfzwiH -zwiH -zwi. — (Delicate, soft) komalaH -lA -laM, pelavaH -vA -vaM, mfduH -dvI -du, sukumAraH -rA -rI -raM. — (Not coarse, fine) asTUlaH -lA -laM, sUkzmaH &c., viralaH &c. — (Pleasing, agreeable) ruciraH -rA -raM, suBagaH -gA -gaM, ramyaH -myA -myaM, manoramaH -mA -maM, sundaraH -rA -rI -raM.
NICELY: I Exactly, accurately: viSudDam. II Well: Somanam.III Agreeably. rUciram.

NICELY , adv. (Exactly, accurately) sUkzmaM, sOkzmyeRa, sasOkzmyaM, sUkzma- rUpeRa, sUkzmatvena, aYjasA, samaYjasaM, samyak. — (Well, in a good manner) su prefixed, suzWuH; ‘nicely done,’ sukftaH -tA -taM.

NICENESS, NICETY: I Delicacy:(1) lAlityam; (2) svAdutA.II Agreeableness: rUciratA.III Exactness, accuracy: viSudDatA.IV Fine- -ness, minuteness: sUkzmatA: v. Fastidious- -ness: sUkzmapriyatA.V Delicate management: perh. vEdagDyam.

NICENESS , NICETY, s. (Delicacy, deliciousness) svAdutA, surasatvaM, sOrasyaM, mizwatA. — (Pleasantness) ruciratA, rucyatA, ramyatA, ramaRI- yatA. — (Exactness) sUkzmatA -tvaM, sOkzmyaM, sAmaYjasyaM, samyaktvaM, SudDatA. — (Over-exactness or scrupulousness) atisUkzmatA, atisOkzmyaM. — (Delicacy of perception or judgment) sUkzmadfzwiH f. -zwitvaM, sUkzmamatitvaM, kuSAgrIyamatitvaM, kuSAgrabudDitvaM. — (Delicacy of manage- ment) yuktiH f., suyuktiH f., lAGavaM, sunItiH f.
Niche, s. (pratimA-) ADAraH, niketanaM, sTAnaM.
NICHE: perh. takram (comp. Bengali tAk).
NICHE , s. pratimAsTAnaM, pratimADAraH, pratimAniketaH -tanaM.
Nick, s. graMTiH; avacCedaH. 2 SuBa-anukUla-samayaH, yukta-ucita-kAlaH, SuBayogaH-kAlaH-lagnaM. v. t. avacCid 7 P. 2 SuBalagne Asad c.
NICK (subs.): I Notch: granTiH, n. of propi- tious reckoning: saMKyAmaNgalagranTiH, U. iii.II Of time: SumakzaRaH; upayuktasamayaH; and sim. comps.
NICK , s. (Of time) kAlasanDiH m., kAlayogaH, SuBakAlaH, SuBayogaH, suyogaH, SuBalagnaM, SuBakzaRaH, yuktasamayaH, upayuktasamayaH, upayuktakAlaH, ucitasamayaH, aRiH m. — (Notch) CedaH, avacCedaH.
To NICK , v. a. (Touch at the right time) SuBalagne spfS (c. 6. spfSati, sprazwuM) or Asad (c. 10. -sAdayati -yituM), suyuktiM kf. — (Make a notch) avacCedaM kf.
Nickname, s. saMjYA, upADiH, upADinAman n. v. t. upADiM dA 3 U.
NICKNAME (subs.): apanAman (n (?): saMjYA, (appellation), got the n. of hare-eater: SaSAda- saMjYAmavApa, U. p.
NICKNAME (v.): apanAma karoti (?). N. d: -apa- nAman (mfn.); -saMjYa (f. jYA).
NICKNAME , s. upADiH m., upADinAma n. (n), nindAnAma n., nindAsUcakaM nAma, tiraskArasUcakanAma, apamAnArTakaM nAma.
To NICKNAME , v. a. upADiM dA, upADinAma kf, tiraskArArTaM nAma dA.
Nictate, v. i. nimiz 6 P; ni-mIl 1 P. [Nictat]ion, s. nimezaH; nimIlanaM.
To NICTATE , v. n. nimiz (c. 6. -mipati -mezituM), pakzivad nimezaM kf.
NICTATION , s. nimezaH, nimIlanaM, pakzinimezaH, pakzivad nimezaH.
NICTITATING MEMBRANE , s. pakziRAM cakzurAvaraRaM, pakzinetrapawalaM.
Nidification, s. nIqakaraRaM, kulAyaracanaM.
NIDIFICATION , s. nIqakaraRaM, nIqaracanaM, kulAyaracanA.
Niece, s. BrAtfkanyA-sutA, BrAtrIyA. 2 (Sisterʼs daughter) BAgineyI, svasrIyA.
NIECE: I Brother's daughter:(1) BrAtuzputrI; (2) BrAtfjA (rare).II Sister's d.:(1) BAgineyI; (2) svasrIyA (rare), maternal n.: mAtfzvasreyI, M.
NIECE , s. (Brother's daughter) BrAtrIyA, BrAtfjA, BrAtfputrI, BrAtfsutA, BrAtfkanyA. — (Sister's daughter) svasrIyA, BAgineyI, svasfputrI, BaginIsutA, BaginIkanyA, svasfjA.
Niggard, s. kfpaRaH, kzudraH, kadaryaH. [Niggard]ly, a. kfpaRa, kzudra, kadarya, tyAgavimuKa (KI f.), badDamuzwi. adv. kfpaRavat, alpavyayena. [Niggard]ness, s. kArpaRyaM, kadaryatA; See Miser, &c.
NIGGARD: kfpaRa (f. RA): v. Miser.
NIGGARD , s. kfpaRajanaH, adAtA m. (tf), kadaryyajanaH, gAQamuzwiH m.

NIGGARD , NIGGARDLY, a. dfQamuzwiH -zwiH -zwi, gAQamuzwiH &c., kfpaRaH -RA -RaM, vyayaSaNkI -NkinI -Nki (n), vyayaSaNkitaH -tA -taM, alpavyayI &c., [Page533-a+ 51] svalpavyayI &c., kadaryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, matsaraH -rA -raM, tanutyAgaH -gA -gaM, tyAgaparANmuKaH -KA -KaM, dAnaparANmuKaH &c., kzudraH -drA -draM, arTaparaH -rA -raM. See MISER, MISERLY.
NIGGARDLINESS: (1) kfpaRatA (= miserliness); (2) badDamuzwitA (= close-fistedness);(3) tanu- tyAgitA (parsimony).
NIGGARDLINESS , NIGGARDNESS, s. kfpaRatA, kArpaRyaM, kadaryyatA -tvaM, vyayaSaNkA, svalpavyayaH, dfQamuzwitvaM, mAtsaryyaM, dAnaparANmuKatA.
NIGGARDLY: (1) kfpaRa (f. RA);(2) badDamuzwi (mfn.);(3) tanutyAga (f. gA); For dif.: v. N.ness.
NIGGARDLY adv. sakArpaRyaM, kfpaRavat, svalpavyayena, vyayaSaNkayA.
Niggle, v. i. kAlApavyayaM kf 8 U

Night, s. rAtri-trI, rajaniH-nI, kzapA, niSA, viBAvarI, Sa(SA)rvarI, yAminI, triyAmA, niSITinI, kzaRadA, tamasvinI, tamiH-mI-mA, (all f.); ‘a dark n(ight)’ tamisrA, tAmasI; ‘moonlight n(ight)’ jyOtsnI, jyotizmatI; ‘by n(ight)’, ‘at n(ight)’ rAtrO, niSi, naktaM, dozA; ‘number of n(ight)s’ gaRarAtraM; ‘beginning of n(ight)’ pradozaH, rajanImuKaM, niSAmuKaM; ‘n(ight) and day’ rAtriMdivaM, naktaMdivaM; ‘a n(ight) and 2 days’ pakziRI; ‘sitting up at n(ight)’ rAtri-jAgaraH; ‘n(ight)-attack’ sOptikaM, sOptikAkramaH; ‘n(ight)-blindness’ rAtryaMDatA; ‘n(ight)-dress’ rAtriveSaH; ‘n(ight)-fall’ pradozaH, niSA-rajanI-muKaM, saMDyAkAlaH, rAtriyogaH; ‘n(ight)-hag’ rAtricarA, rAtryawA; ‘n(ight)-man’ Kala-mala-pUH; ‘n(ight)-mare’ duHsvapnaH, kusvapnaH; ‘n(ight)-shade’ nidigDikA, spfSI, vyAGrI, bfhatI, kaMwakA-rikA, pracodanI, kulI, kzudrA, duHsparSA, rAzwrIkArAzwrikA; ‘n(ight)-wandering’ niSAcara, rAtri(triM)cara; ‘n(ight)-watch’ nagararakziRaH (pl.); yAmaH, praharaH. [Night]ly, a. nESa (SI f.), dozAtana (nI f.), (s.) in comp.; ‘n(ightly) watch’ rAtrijAgaraRaM. adv. rAtrO, niSi, naktaM. 2 pratirAtraM, niSiniSi, rAtrO rAtrO.

NIGHT: (1) rajanI, at n.: rajanyAm, V.; in the depth of n.: gAQAyAM rajanyAm, K.; n. with the moon (just) risen but darkness not (quite) dispelled: udgatenduraviminnatamisrA rajanI, Ki. ix. 36.;(2) rAtriH, the n. has passed: rAtrirgatA, R.; day and n.: ahorAtram: v. Day.: for three n.s: trirAtram, Vas.; when mid.-n. was oozing away: galati maDyarAtre, D. viii.; I will reside here one n.: atra vasAmyekAM rAtrim, K.s. xviii. 255.:(3) niSA, end of n.: niSAvasAnam, B. xi. 17.;(4) viBAvarI, in the fourth watch of n.: viBAvaryAH turIye yAme, C.; (5) SarvarI, to pass a n.: SarvarIM gamayati, Si. xi. 5.;(6) kzapA, in autumnal full-moonlight n.s: pariRataSaraccandrikAsu kzapAsu, Me. ii. 49.;(7) yAminI; (8) kzaRadA;(9) triyAmA. At n.: niSi, naktam, Gi.; n. -walker: niSAcaraH, rajanIcaraH, etc.; n. -blindness: rAtryanDatA; n. -dew: niSAtuzAram; n. -waking: rAtrijAgaraRam; etc.

NIGHT , s. rAtriH f., niSA, rajanI, kzaRadA, kzapA, SarvvarI, niw f. NIGHT-MAN: *niSAsamBArjakaH and sim. comp.s.

NIGHT-WALKING , NIGHT-WANDERING, a. niSAcaraH -rA -rI -raM, rAtricaraH &c., rAtriYcaraH &c., rajanIcaraH &c., niSAcArA -riRI -ri (n), naktacArI &c., naktaYcaraH &c.

NIGHT-WATCH , s. yAmaH, praharaH, rAtriyAmaH, rAtripraharaH.
NIGHTCAP: nESaM Siraskam, and sim. expr.s.
NIGHTFALL: (1) niSAgamaH;(2) dinAntaH;(3) rajanImuKam; etc.

NIGHTINGALE: *priyagItaH; bulbulaH.
NIGHTINGALE , s. vasantadUtaH, madanadUtaH, kokilaH gAtuH m.
NIGHTLY (adj.): (1) nESaH (SI, SaM);(2) SArvaraH (rI, raM);(3) dozAtanaH (nI, naM).
NIGHTLY (adv.): I By night:(1) by loc.: rAtrO, etc.;(2) niSi;(3) naktam.II Every night:(1) pratirAtram:(2) niSi niSi; etc.
NIGHTLY , a. nESaH -SI -SaM, prAdozikaH -kI -kaM, rAtrikftaH -tA -taM, rAtrijaH -jA -jaM, SArvaraH -rI -raM, prAtirAtrikaH -kI -kaM.
NIGHTLY , adv. (By night) rAtrO, naktaM, niSAyAM, niSi, dozA. — (Every night) pratirAtraM, pratiniSaM, rAtrO rAtrO, niSi niSi.

NIGHTPIECE: *rAtridfSyam; rajanIcitram.
NIGHTSHADE: kaRwakArI (a prickly n.).

NIMBLE: laGu (f. GvI) (= light and gay).

NIMBLE , a. laGuH -GuH -GvI -Gu, laGugatiH -tiH -ti, drutagatiH &c., tvari- tagatiH &c., laGuSarIraH -rA -raM, laGudehaH -hA -haM, capalANgaH -NgA -NgaM, aNgacapalaH -lA -laM, capaladehaH -hA -haM, capalagatiH &c., kzipragatiH &c., kziprakArI -riRI -ri (n), ASukArI &c., tIkzRakarmmA -rmmA -rmma (n), capalaH -lA -laM, caYcalaH -lA -laM.

NIMBLE-HANDED , a. laGuhastaH -stA -staM, capalapARiH -RiH -Ri, pARi- capalaH &c.
NIMBLE-WITTED , a. vapalabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, kziprabudDiH &c., SIGrabudDiH &c.
NIMBLENESS: lAGavam: v. Lightness, activity.

NIMBLY: salAGavam: v. Lightly, quickly.
NIMBLY , adv. salAGavaM, lAGavena, laGu, laGugatyA, drutaM, drutagatyA, tvaritaM, tvaritagatyA, cApalyena, capalaM, capalagatyA, aNgacApalyena, kzipraM, SIGraM.

Nine, a., s. navan; ‘n(ine)-fold’ navaguRa. Ninth, a. navama (mI f.); ‘n(inth)ly’ ‘in the n(inth) place’ navamasTAnaM. Nineteen, a., s. navadaSan, UnaviMSati f.; ‘n(ineteen)th’ navadaSa (SI f.). Ninety, a., s. navati f.
NINE: navan (mfn.), n. or ten: navadaSAH (n. -ni); n. times: navavArAn; in n. ways: navaDA; of n. kinds: navaviDaH (DA, DaM); n. gems of Vikramā- ditya: vikramasya nava ratnAni, Ja.
NINE , a. nava m. f. n. pl. (n), navasaMKyakaH -kA -kaM.
NINE-FOLD , a. navaguRaH -RA -RaM, navaviDaH -DA -DaM, navaDA indecl.
NINEFOLD: navaguRitam: v. Nine.
NINETEEN: (1) navadaSan (mfn.);(2) UnaviMSatiH (f.).
NINETEEN , a. navadaSa m. f. n. pl. (n), UnaviMSatiH f. sing., ekonaviM- SatiH f. sing., navadaSasaMKyakaH -kA -kaM.
NINETEENTH: (2) navadaSaH (SI, SaM):(2) UnaviMSaH (SI, SaM);(3) UnaviMSatitamaH (mI, maM).
NINETEENTH , a. navadaSaH -SI -SaM, ekonaviMSaH -SI -SaM, UnaviMSaH &c., UnaviMSatitamaH -mI -maM, ekonaviMSatitamaH &c.
NINETIETH , a. navataH -tI -taM, navatitamaH -mI -maM.
NINETY: navati (f.); n. -nine: navanavatiH; n. times: navativArAn; n. -fold: navatiguRitam; in n. ways: navatiDA.

(n), daSamIsTaH, daSamINgataH.
NINETY-FOLD , a. navatiguRaH -RA -RaM, navativiDaH -DA -DaM, navatiDA indecl.
Ninny, s. alpaDIH, mUrKaH, jaqaH.
NINNY: alpabudDi (mfn.): v. Fool.
NINNY , NINNY-HAMMER, s. alpabudDiH m., alpaDIH m., mUrKaH, nirbudDiH
NINTH: navamaH (mI, maM). N.-ly: navamam; navamataH.
NINTH , a. navamaH -mI -maM, nAvamikaH -kI -kaM.
NINTHLY , adv. navamatas, navatas, navamasTAne, navamapade.

details.body: Nip, v. t. ni-, kft 6 P, avaCid 7 P. 2 saMdaMS 1 P, carv 1 P, 10. 3 pIq 10, ard 1 P or c. 4 naS c., ucCid, viSF 6 P or c.; mlAnIkf 8 U; ‘n(ip) in the bud’ kalikAvasTAyAM eva naS c., jAtamAtraM han 2 P or praSamaM nI 1 P, (jAtamAtraM na yaH SatruM vyADiM ca praSamaM nayet P. iii. 1). [Nip]ping, s. nikfMtanaM, avacCedaH. 2 himArtI-karaRaM. [Nip]ped, a. Cinna, pIqita, &c. 3 himArta, himapIqita. Nippers, s. saMdaMSaH-SakaH, kaMkamuKaM.
NIP: I To pinch: nizpIqayati (pIq, c. 10.) (?).II To cut off: nikfntati (kft, c. 6.). III To destroy: q. v.: nASayati (c. of naS). Ph.: to n. in the bud: jAtamAtraM hanti, ni-, (han, c. 2.).

To NIP , v. a. (Cut or pinch off with the ends of the fingers) aNgulpagrEH or aNgulinaKEr avaCid (c. 7. -Cinatti -CettuM) or avakft (c. 6. -kfntati -karttituM) or nikft or Cid or pIq. — (Bite off) daMS (c. 1. daSati, daMzwuM), vidaMS, sandaMS, avadaMS. — (Pinch in general) pIq (c. 10. pIqayati -yituM), maT (c. 1. maTati, c. 9. maTnAti -TituM), ArttaM -rttAM -rttaM kf, ArttAkf; as, ‘to pinch with cold,’ SItena pIq SItArttIkf, himArttIkf. — (Blast, destroy) naS (c. 10. nASayati -yituM), duz (c. 10. dUzayati -yituM), mf (c. 10. mArayati -yituM), viSF (c. 10. -SAra- yati -yituM), mlAnIkf.
NIP , NIPPING, s. naKEr avaCedaH or avakfntanaM or nikfntanaM or kfntanaM, himArttIkaraRaM, SItArttIkaraRaM, himanASaH.
NIPPED , p. p. (With cold) himapIqitaH -tA -taM, himArttaH -rttA -rttaM, SItArttaH &c., himadUzitaH -tA -taM, himanASitaH &c. — (In general) pIqitaH -tA -taM, maTitaH &c.
NIPPERS: (1) saMdaMSaH, -kaH;(2) kaNkamuKaH.
NIPPERS , s. pl. sandaMSaH -SakaM -SakA, kaNkamuKaM.
Nipple, s. cUcukaH-kaM, stana-kuca-agraM, stana-muKaM.
NIPPLE: (1) cUcukam or cucukam;(2) stanAgram;(3) kucAgram.
NIPPLE , s. stanAgraM, stanamuKaM -KaH, stanaSiKA, kucAgraM, cUcukaH -kaM, stana- vfntaH -ntaM, pizpalakaM, narmmaWaH, vfntaM; ‘the nipples,’ puraSCadO m. du.
Nit, s. likzA, yUkAMqaM. [Nit]ty, a. likzApUrRa.
NIT: (1) likzA;(2) nikzA;(3) rikzA;(4) diNkaH.
NIT , s. likzA, nikzA, rikzA, diNkaH, yUkARqaM.

NITRE: (1) yavakzAraH;(2) yavalASaH;(3) yavaSUkaH; (4) yavajaH.
NITRE , s. yavakzAraH, yavajaH, tarkzyaH, pAkyaH, tIkzRaH, tIkzRarasaH, yavalAsaH, yavAgrajaH.
Nitrogen, s. nirguRavAyu m.
NITROGEN: *nizprARavAyuH; yavakzArajanakaH. Nitric acid: *nizprARAmlaH. Nitrous acid: *upanizprARAmlaH.

NIVEOUS , a. himyaH -myA -myaM, tuzAramayaH -yI -yaM, himanayaH &c.
