sanskrit.iast: na neti ca tvādṛśi vāg vigarhṛṇā

details.body: No, adv. na, no, nahi; ‘n(o), n(o)’ mA mEvaM. a. (Before nouns) ex. by na; a, an, nir pr.; hIna, SUnya, rahita in comp., ‘n(o) one’ na kopi, na kaScana; ‘n(o)-body’ na kaScit, na kAcana; ‘having n(o) issue’ anapatya, vaMSahIna, &c.

NO (adv.): na, no, no, become the ornament of my lap: na na madutsaNgaviBUzaRaM Bava, N. ix. 114.; and to say ‘no, no’ to one like you would be rebuking: na neti ca tvAdfSi vAg vigarhfRA, N. ix. 25.; to this we say ‘no’: atrocyate ‘na’, S.; there is no greater fault than this: nAtaH parataro dozaH, H. N.B. Use ‘yes’ in Sanskrit for ‘no’ after negative interrogation, ‘has not this come to Chandragupta's ears? No, Sir: na Kalu vfzalasya SravaRamupagato'yaM..Arya, aya kim, Mu. iii.

NO (adj.): (1) na, he is no other than Arjuna: nEzo'nyaH savyasAcinaH, Mah.; and there is no cessa- tion of sorrow but from spiritual knowledge: na cAnyatra paramAtmajYAnAcCokavinivfttirasti, S. iii. 8.; (2) a (or an before vowels), if forced no evidence: balAtkAritamapramARam, V.s.; paying no attention: anAdftya, Sa.; seeing no other recourse; anyadupAyAntaramapaSyan, K.
No , adv. na, no, nahi; ‘or no,’ na vA.

No , a. (None) usually expressible by na; as, ‘no one,’ na kaScit m., na kAcit f., na ko'pi m., na kApi f., na kaScana m., na kAcana f.; ‘no thing,’ na kiYcit, na kimapi, na kiYcana; ‘no other,’ nAnyaH -nyA -nyat; ‘no where,’ na kvacit, na kvApi, na kutracit, na kutrApi; ‘no more, not again,’ na punar; ‘no great distance,’ nAtidUraM. When ‘no’ is privative, it is expressed by nir, a, vi &c. prefixed, or by hIna, SUnya, varjita, rahita &c. affixed; as, ‘having no fruit,’ nizPalaH -lA -laM, aPalaH &c., viPalaH &c., PalahInaH -nA -naM, &c.

NO ONE: (1) na ko'pi; (f. kA'pi), there is n. without some stain: nAstyakalaNkaH ko'pi, Va.; (2) na kaScit (f. kAcit), n. is one's friend: na kaScit kasyacinmitram, H.;(3) na kaScana (f. kAcana) (rare): v. None.
NO WAY , NO WAYS, NO WISE, adv. na kaTaYcana, na kaTaYcit, na kaTa- mapi, na sarvvaTA, na sarvvaTEva.
NOBILITY: I Of rank or birth: no equiv.: kOlInyam may occasionally do; mahattvam (= greatness).II Noblemen collectively: *anurAjavargaH; nAyakasampradAyaH.III Greatness: eminence: mahattvam.

NOBILITY , s. (Antiquity of family, elevation of rank) mahAkulatA, kulInatA, maMhAkulInatA, satkulInatA, aBijAtatA, ABijAtyaM, ABi- janaM, kulotkarzaH, kulotkfzwatA, OtkarzaM, kOlInaM, sadvaMSatA, vaMSotkarzaH. — (Elevation or greatness of mind) mAhAtmyaM, mahAtmatA -tvaM, mahimA m. (n), mahattvaM, udAratA, OdAryyaM, cittodAratA, mahecCA, mahAnuBAvaH. — (Distinction, eminence) utkarzaH, utkfzwatA, OtkarzaM, vESizwyaM, vi- SizwatA, praDAnatA -tvaM, samunnatiH f., prakarzaH, SizwatA, SrezWatvaM, sevyatA, suKyAtiH f. — (Magnificence) pratApaH, tejas n., SrIH f. — (The nobility, noblemen collectively) kulInalokaH, kulInajanasamUhaH, kulInajanAH m. pl., SizwajanAH m. pl., kulInasamUhaH, rAjanyakaM.

Noble, a. kulIna, aBijAta, Arya, aBijanavat, mahAkula, satkulajAta, sadvaMSaja, kula-ja or jAta, kulaprasUta, vaMSaviSudDa. 2 (‘N(oble)-minded’) udAra, mahAtman, mahAmanas, udAtta, udAra-DI-mati, mahAnuBAva, mahASaya, mahecCa. 3 mahat, DIra, SrezWa, utkfzwa, viSizwa, uttama, mahABAga, unnata, pramuKa, praSasta, vi-pra-KyAta, pratipatti-mat, supratizWa, kIrtimat, yaSasvin; SrImat, mahApratApa, mahAtejas, tejasvin, ojasvin; See Majestic also; oft. ex. by fzaBaH, siMhaH, vyAGraH, puMgavaH, SArdUlaH in comp.; See, Excellent; ‘n(oble)-looking’ DIradarSana; mahAnuBAvAkfti; ‘n(oble) in reason’ udAttaDI ‘n(oble) animal’ udAttasattvaM; ‘n(oble) nature’ sattvaM. s., ‘N(oble)-man’ SizwajanaH, kulInaH, kulIna-utkfzwa-padasTaH, AryajanaH, aBijanavat m. [Noble]ness, s. mahattvaM, mahiman m., utkarzaH, unnati f., SrezWatA &c.; pratApaH, vEBavaM; See below. Nobly, adv. kulInavat, ABijA-tyena; ‘n(obly) born’ kulotpanna; See (a.). 2 OdAryeRa, udAratayA, mAhAtmyena, udAra-cetasA, udAttaM, DIraM. 3 sapratApaM, atitejasA, mahAviBUtyA, ESvaryeRa. Nobility, s. kulInatA, AryatA, ABijAtyaM, kulotkarzaH, sadvaMSatA. 2 OdAryaM, mAhAtmyaM, mahAnuBAvaH, udAraDIH; mahASayaH, mahiman m. 3 mahattvaM, mahimA, utkarzaH, viSizwatA, SrezWatvaM, prakarzaH, unnatiH, pratipatti f., pratizWA, pra-vi-KyAti f. 4 pratApaH, ESvaryaM, viBUti f., ojas-tejas n., DIratA, SrIH. 5 Sizwa-kulIna-janaH, kulInalokAH-janAH. Noblesse, s. kulIna-janAH, kulInajanasamAjaH.
NOBLE, NOBLEMAN (subs.): *anurAjaH, nAyakaH.
NOBLE (adj.): I Of birth or rank: kulInaH (nA, naM) (?); of n. blood: kulajaH, N.; mahat (f. tI) (= great).II Great, eminent: q. v.: mahat (f. tI).

NOBLE , a. (Of ancient family, or elevated rank) kulInaH -nA -naM, mahAkulInaH -nA -naM, mahAkulaH -lA -laM, satkulInaH -nA -naM, sadvaMSaH -SA -SaM, aBijanavAn -vatI -vat (t), aBijAtaH -tA -taM, utkfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, utkfzwakulajAtaH -tA -taM, mahAkulajaH -jA -jaM, mahAkulaprasUtaH -tA -taM, satkulajAtaH -tA -taM, viSudDakulaBavaH, vaMSaviSudDaH -dDA -dDaM, sadvaMSa- jAtaH -tA -taM, praDAnavaMSodBavaH -vA -vaM, mahAvaMSIyaH -yA -yaM, uttamavaMSa- jAtaH -tA -taM, kulaSrezWI -zWinI -zWi (n), SrezWakulodBUtaH -tA -taM, kulo- dgataH -tA -taM, kulikaH -kA -kaM, kOleyaH -yI -yaM, pratipattimAn &c. — (Great in mind) udAraH -rA -raM, udAramanAH -nAH -naH (s), udAra- matiH -tiH -ti, udAraDIH -DIH -Di, mahAtmA -tmA -tma (n), mahAmanAH &c., mahAmanaskaH -skA -skaM, mAhAtmikaH -kI -kaM, mahAmatiH -tiH -ti, mahAnuBAvaH -vA -vaM, mahecCaH -cCA -cCaM, mahASayaH -yA -yaM, unnatamanAH &c. — (Distinguished, eminent, excellent) utkfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, SrezWaH -zWA -zWaM, atyutkfzwaH &c., SizwaH -zwA -zwaM, viSizwaH &c., uttamaH -mA -maM, pramuKaH -KA -KaM, unnataH -tA -taM, samunnataH -tA -taM, praSastaH -stA -staM, mahAn -hatI -hat (t), mahABAgaH -gA -gaM, mahABAgaDeyaH -yA -yaM, sevyaH -vyA -vyaM. — (Illustrious) KyAtaH -tA -taM, viKyAtaH -tA -taM, yaSasvI &c., mahA- yaSAH &c., SrImAn &c., supratizWaH -zWA -zWaM, kIrttimAn &c. — (Mag- nificent) mahApratApaH -pA -paM, mahAtejAH &c., viBUtimAn &c., SrImAn &c. ‘Noble’ may sometimes be expressed by fzaBaH or puNgavaH or vyAGraH or siMhaH or SArdUlaH or indraH in comp.; as, ‘a noble or eminent man,’ puruzarzaBaH, puruzavyAGraH, narapuNgavaH, narendraH &c.; ‘a noble elephant,’ gajendraH; ‘noble nature,’ sattvaM; ‘noble on both sides,’ mAtftaH pitftaScABijanavAn &c.
NOBLE , NOBLEMAN, s. kulInajanaH, kulInalokaH, SizwajanaH, SizwalokaH, kulInapadasTaH, uccapadasTaH, utkfzwapadasTaH, kulaSrezWI m. (n), satkulInaH, aBijanavAn m. (t), rAjanyaH.
NOBLE-MINDED , a. udAramanAH -nAH -naH (s), udAraDIH -DIH -Di, udA- ramanaskaH -skA -skaM, udAracetAH &c., mahAtmA -tmA -tma (n), samBAvi- tAtmA &c., mahecCaH -cCA -cCaM.
NOBLENESS, NOBLESSE: mahattvam: v. Nobility.
NOBLENESS , s. mahattvaM, mahimA m. (n), utkarzaH, utkfzwatA, SrezWatA, praDAnatA, udAratA, OdAryyaM, unnatiH f., samunnatiH. See NOBILITY.
NOBLESSE , s. kOlInyaM, kOlInaM, kulInalokaH, kulInasamUhaH, kulInasaBA.
NOBLY: I With ref. to descent: n. descen- ded: kulInaH (nA, naM), etc.II Eminently: splendidly: atitejasA.

NOBLY , adv. (With nobleness of birth) kulInaM, kulInavat, sABi- jAtyaM; ‘nobly-born,’ mahAkulaprasUtaH -tA -taM, satkulajAtaH -tA -taM. See NOBLE, a. (With greatness of mind) sOdAryyaM, OdAryyeRa, udAravat, samAhAtmyaM, mAhAtmyena, manomahattvAt, mahimnA, udAracittatvAt, udAracetasA, mahecCayA. — (Magnificently) mahApratApena, mahAtejasA, atitejasA, sapratApaM, ESvaryyeRa.
NOBODY , s. na kaScit m., na kAcit f., na ko'pi m., na kApi f., na kaScana m., na kAcana f.
NOCENT , a. hiMsraH -srA -sraM, hiMsAluH -luH -lu, apakArakaH -kA -kaM.
NOCTAMBULATION , s. nidrABramaRaM, nidrApariBramaRaM, nidrAcAraH.
NOCTAMBULIST , s. nidrAcArI m. (n), nidrABramaRakft. See NIGHT-WALKING.
Noctavagant, a. rAtricara.
NOCTIVAGANT , a. niSAcaraH -rA -rI -raM, naktacArI -riRI &c. See NIGHT-WALKING.
NOCTURNAL; nESaH (SI, SaM): v. Nightly.

NOCTURNAL , a. nESaH -SI -SaM, rAtrikAlikaH -kI -kaM, rAtrisambanDI nDinI &c., rAtrikAlasambanDI &c., dozAtanaH -nI -naM, prAdozikaH -kI -kaM, SArvvaraH -rI -raM, rAtrIyaH -yA -yaM, niSAsambanDIyaH -yA -yaM.

Nod, s. SiraH-kaMpaH-cAlanaM, SiraHsaMjYA-saMketaH. 2 SiraH-mastaka-praRAmaH. v. (mastakaM, SiraH) cal c.; ‘Mālati n(od)s her head’ mAlatI mUrDAnaM cAlayati (Mal. 8); SirasA saMketaM-saMjYAM kf 8 U or dA 3 U; ‘n(od) consent’ SiraHkaMpena anuman 4 A or anumatiM sUc 10. 2 (SiraH) pra-A-vi-ava-nam c. (namayati).

NOD (subs.): SiraHkampaH or mUrDnaH kampaH, Ku. vii. 46.; forbidden by a n.: SiraHkampasaMjYAvAritA, D. vi.; whose entry was permitted with a mere n. (lit. turning of the eye-brow): BrUkzepamAtrAnumatapraveSAm, Ku. iii. 60.
NOD (v.): I To salute: namati (nam, c. 1.), Ku. vi. 89.II Of kings: SiraHkampena anu- manyate (man, c. 4 (to asesntassent or permit) or Ahvayati (hve, c. 1.) (to call).

To NOD , v. a. or n., (Incline the head) SiraH or mastakaM nam (c. 1. namati, nantuM, c. 10. namayati -yituM) or praRam or aBinam or vinam or Anam. — (Make a sign by a motion of the head) mastaka- saNketaM kf, SiraHsaNketaM kf, SirasA saNketaM kf or saMjYAM kf or iNgitaM kf, SiraS cal (c. 10. cAlayati -yituM).

NOD , s. (Inclination of the head) SiraHpraRAmaH, mastakapraRAmaH, SiraH- praRatiH f. — (Sign made by a movement of the head) mastaka- saNketaH, SiraHsaNketaH, SirasA saNketaH or saMjYA or iNgitaM, mastakasandeSaH, SiraScAlanaM.
Nodated, a. graMTila, graMTimat.
NODATED , a. granTimAn -matI -mat (t), granTilaH -lA -laM.
NODDING: I Subs.: praRatiH.II Adj.: nataH (tA, taM) (?).
NODDLE , s. mastakaH -kaM, Siras n., SIrzakaM, muRqakaM.
NODDY: alpabudDiH: v. Simpleton, fool.
NODDY , s. alpabudDiH m., alpaDIH m., mUrKaH, nirbudDiH m.
Node, s. pAtaH. 2 asTigulmaH, gaMqaH, piMqaH.
NODE: pAtaH. Ascending n.: praTamaH sampAtaH, Go.; pUrvArdDapAtaH. Descending n.: dvitIyaH sampAtaH, Go.; parArdDapAtaH.
NODE , s. (In surgery) asTigulmaH, aDyasTi n. — (In astronomy) pAtaH, upagrahaH; ‘ascending node,’ rAhuH m., svarBAnuH m., viDuntudaH, sEMhikeyaH, tamas n.; ‘descending,’ ketuH m.
Nodose, a. graMTila, graMTimat.
NODOSE , a. granTilaH -lA -laM, granTI -nTinI -nTi (n), bahugranTiH -nTiH -nTi.
NODOSITY , s. granTilatvaM, granTimattvaM, sagranTitvaM, saparvvatvaM, granTipUrRatA.
Nodule, s. GanaH, piMqaH; SarkarA, lozwaH.
NODULE: perh. piRqaH. Nodular: piRqAkAraH (rA, raM) (?).
NODULE , s. SarkarA, piRqaH -RqaM, GanaH, lozwaH -zwaM -zwuH m.

Noise, s. ni-, nAdaH, DvaniH, SabdaH, ni-, svanaH, GozaH, mahA-ucca-svaraH, utkroSaH, vi-, rAvaH, ravaH, nihrAdaH; ‘rattling n(oise)’ raRitaM, raRa-tkAraH; ‘jingling n(oise)’ kvaRaH, kvaRanaM, kvaRitaM; ‘loud n(oise)’ kalakalaH, kolAhalaH, tumulaM, mahASabdaH-svanaH-GozaH. 2 janaravaH-pravAdaH-Sruti f.; ‘make n(oise)’ nad 1 P, Dvan 1 P, vi-, ru 2 P, raR 1 P, SabdAyate (D.), kolAhalaM-kalakalaM-kf 8 U; ‘shallow water makes great n(oise)’ arDo Gawo Gozamu-pEti nUnaM. v. t. Guz 10, ut-vi-°, prakAS c., pra-, KyA c. (KyApayati), prakawIkf. [Noise]ful, a. saSabda; See Noisy, below. [Noise]less, a. niHSabda, nIrava, nirGoza. [Noise]lessly, adv. niHSabdaM, nIravaM. Noisy, a. mahASabda-svana-nAda, tumula-mahASabda-kolAhala-kArin, mu-Kara, GozaRa, GozakArin, Gozakara (rI f.). bahu-mahA-Goza; badDa-kfta-kalakala. 2 ninAda-pUrita, kalakalavyApta, muKara, saSabda, nAdin, saM-ni-hrAdin. [Nois]ily, adv. uccEH-svareRa, mahA-Sabdena. [Nois]iness, s. mahASabdaH-DvaniH.

NOISE (subs.): (1) nAdaH, ni-, soft and high n.: snigDatAro nAdaH, Mah.; with the n. of the lions: kesariRAM ninAdena, K.;(2) SabdaH (sound), with the n. of the hunter's feet: mfgayanAM caraRaSabdena, K.; (3) DvaniH (= low s.), the n. of bow-strings and swords: SarAsanajyAtalavAraRaDvaniH, Ki.;(4) ravaH, virAvaH (= cry: q.v.):(5) DvAnaH (= 3); (6) raRitam or kvanitam (= harsh n.);(7) nihrAdaH or saMhrAdaH (= murmuring, roaring n.);(8) kalakalaH or kolAhalaH (= loud confused n.), when the n. of the hunting ceased: praSAnte tasmin mfgayAkalakale, K.
NOISE, TO MAKE: (1) nadati, ni- (nad, c. 1.); (2) Dvanati (Dvan, c. 1.);(3) SabdAyate (nomi.); (4) raRati (raR, c. 1.): v. Noise.
NOISE (v. t.): Gozayati, A-, vi-, (Guz, c. 10.), “n.d abroad”: viGozitaH (tA, taM).

NOISE , s. SabdaH, mahASabdaH, atiSabdaH, DvaniH m., mahADvaniH m., svanaH, mahAsvanaH, niHsvanaH, GozaH -GaRaM -RA, mahAGozaH, nAdaH, mahAnAdaH, svaraH, mahAsvaraH, uccEHsvaraH, uccasvaraH, praGozakaH, prasvAnaH, nirGozaH, ninAdaH, raRatkAraH, kvaRaH, saMhrAdaH, nihrAdaH, raRaH, raRatkAraH, rAvaH, udrAvaH, kolAhalaH, rAsaH, rAvaRaM, tumulaM, DvanaH, baRaH, utkroSaH. — (Public talk) janavAdaH, janapravAdaH, janaravaH, janaSrutiH f.

To NOISE , v. a. (Spread by report) Guz (c. 10. Gozayati -yituM), viGuz, prakAS (c. 10. -kASayati -yituM), vikAS, KyA in caus. (KyApayati -yituM), AKyA, viKyA, pracar (c. 10. -cArayati -yituM), prakawIkf.
NOISED ABROAD , p. p. GozitaH -tA -taM, viGozitaH -tA -taM, pracAritaH -tA -taM, prakASitaH -tA -taM, prakawitaH &c., prakawIkftaH &c., AKyAtaH &c.
NOISEFUL , a. SabdakArI -riRI &c., Dvanayan -yantI -yat (t). See NOISY.
NOISELESS: (1) niHSabda (f. bdA);(2) nIravaH (vA, vaM): v. Silent, mute.
NOISELESS , a. niHSabdaH -bdA -bdaM, niSSabdaH &c., aSabdaH &c., aGozaH -zA -zaM, nIravaH -vA -vaM, aravaH -vA -vaM, SabdahInaH -nA -naM.
NOISELESSLY: (1) niHSabdam;(2) nIravam: v. Silently.
NOISELESSLY , adv. Sabdena vinA, aSabdena, niHSabdaM, niSSabdaM.
NOISILY: kolAhalaM or kalakalaM kftvA: v. Noise, noisy.
NOISILY , adv. mahASabdena, atiSabdena, mahAsvareRa, uccEHsvareRa.
NOISINESS , s. mahASabdakatvaM, mahASabdaH, mahASabdakAritvaM, mahADvaniH m. -nitA, mahAnAdaH -datA, SabdakAritA, SabdavattvaM, saSabdatA, SabdanatvaM.
Noisome, a. durgaMDa, pUtigaMDi, kutsita, duzwa, samala. 2 mAraka, mArAtmaka, kzayakara (rI f.), nASAvaha, GAtuka, bADaka. [Noisome]ness, s. durgaMDaH, pUti f., ugragaMDatA.
NOISOME: utpIqakaH (kA, kaM): v. Fetid, noxi- -ous, insalubrious.

NOISOME , a. (Noxious, destructive) mArakaH -kA -kaM, mArAtmakaH &c., prARanASakaH &c., mftyujanakaH &c., kzayakaraH -rA -raM, vinASakaH &c., prARaharaH -rA -raM, nfSaMsaH -sA -saM, SarAruH -ruH -ru, SArukaH -kA -kaM, GAtukaH -kA -kaM, bADakaH &c., anizwajanakaH &c., ahitakArI -riRI &c. — (Offensive to the smell) durganDaH -nDA -nDaM, durganDI -nDinI -nDi (n), pUtiganDikaH -kA -kaM, kutsitaH -tA -taM.
NOISOMENESS: (1) utpIqakatvam;(2) udvegakaratvam (= offensiveness).
NOISOMENESS , s. durganDatA -tvaM, dOrganDiH m., pUtiganDatA, kutsitaganDaH, ugraganDatA, pUtiH f., kutsitatvaM, kOtsityaM.

NOISY: I Making noise: kftakalakalaH (lA, laM) and sim. comp.s., in the n. crowd: badDakalakale mahAjane, D. iv. To be n.: v. Noise. to make. II Full of noise:(1) vyAptakalakalaH (lA, laM); (2) mahASabda (f. bdA) and sim. comp.s.

NOISY , a. SabdakAraH -rI -raM, mahASabdakAraH -rI -raM, mahASabdakaH -kA -kaM, mahASabdI -bdinI -bdi (n), mahAsvanaH -nA -naM, mahADvanikaH -kA -kaM, mahADvanikaraH -rI -raM, mahAnAdI &c., mahAnAdaH -dA -daM, mahAsvarakaH -kA -kaM, atiSabdanaH -nA -naM, atiSabdavAn -vatI -vat (t), tumulakArI &c., tumulaH -lA -laM, kolAhalakArI &c. kolAhalakft m. f. n., GoraravaH -vA -vaM, muKaraH -rA -raM. — (Clamorous) GozaRaH -RA -RaM, GozakaraH -rI -raM, mahAGozaH -zA -zaM, bahuGozaH -zA -zaM. — (Sounding) SabdanaH -nA -naM, nAdI &c., svanavAn &c., saMhrAdI &c., svanan -nantI -nat (t), Dvanayan &c.
Nomad, [Nomad]ic, a. paSucAraRopajIvin; asTira-vAsa.
NOMAD, NOMADE: *cAraka (f. rikA); nEkatravAsaH (sA, saM).
NOMAD , NOMADIC, a. pracArAnusAravAsI -sinI &c., paSucAraRAnujIvI.
NOMADIC: expr. by gen. or comp., n. tribe: cArakajAtiH.
Nome, s. pra-, deSaH, deSaBAgaH.
NOMENCLATOR: nAmadAtf (f. trI) and sim. comp.s.
NOMENCLATOR , s. nAmasTApakaH, nAmaboDakaH, nAmaKyApakaH.
Nomenclature, s. pariBAzA, pAriBAzika-SabdasaMgrahaH.
NOMENCLATURE: parimAzA, S.k.
NOMENCLATURE , s. SabdasaNgrahaH, SabdajAlaM, SabdamAlA, niGaRwuH m.

Nominal, a. nAmasaMbaMDin, nAmavizayaka. 2 SAbda (bdI f.), SAbdika-vAcanika- (kI f.). 3 nAmamAtra, nAmaDArin-Bft, nAmamAtra-DArin, Sabda-nAma in comp.; ‘I am but a n(ominal) lord of the earth’ nanu SabdapatiH kzite-rahaM (R. viii. 52); ‘n(ominal) verb’ nAmaDAtuH. [Nominal]ly, adv. Sabda-nAma-mAtreRa, nAmata eva, SabdataH.
NOMINAL: I Lit., by comp., n., n. verb: nAma- DAtuH, S.k.II Fig., existing in name only: nAmamAtra (f. trA).

NOMINAL , a. (Pertaining to a name) nAmasambanDI -nDinI &c., nAma- vizayaH -yA -yaM. — (Relating to words) SAbdaH -bdI -bdaM, SAbdikaH -kI -kaM, vAcanikaH -kI -kaM, ABiDAnIyakaH -kI -kaM. — (Existing in name only) nAmaDArI -riRI &c., nAmamAtraDArI &c., nAmaBft m. f. n., SabdaH -bdI -bdaM, SAbdikaH &c. — (Nominal verb). The gram- matical symbol is liGu.
NOMINALIST: vyAptijYAnavisaMvAdin (f. nI) (?).
NOMINALLY: I Lit.: nAmnA.II Fig.: nAma- mAtram; nAmata eva; and sim. comp.s.: v. Only, merely.
NOMINALLY , adv. nAmatas, nAmnA, nAmamAtreRa, Sabdatas, SabdamAtreRa.

Nominate, v. t. nAma-saMjYAM-kf 8 U, nAma nirdiS 6 P; See Call, Name. 2 (To an office) niyuj 7 A, 10 or prati-zWA c. (-zWApayati). [Nominat]ion, s. niyogaH, niyojanaM, pratizWApanaM. [Nominat]ive, s. kartf m., kartfvAcakaH, praTamA viBaktiH. [Nominat]or, s. niyojakaH. Nominee, s. niyuktaH, aDikftaH.
NOMINATE: I To name: q. v.:II To an office: *nirvAcayati (c. of vac), they can n., but cannot appoint: nirvAcayituM na tu niyoktuM te praBavanti.

To NOMINATE , v. a. (Give a name) nAma kf or dA, saMjYAM kf or dA. — (Designate by name) nAma nirdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM) or pradiS. — (Appoint by name to an office) nAma nirdiSya niyuj (c. 7. -yunakti -yoktuM, c. 10. -yojayati -yituM) or parikxp (c. 10. -kalpayati -yituM) or prakxp.
NOMINATED , p. p. nAmanirdeSAnantaraM niyuktaH -ktA -ktaM or niyojitaH -tA -taM.
NOMINATION: nirvAcanam: v. Also appointment.
NOMINATION , s. (Act) nAmanirdeSAnantaraM niyogaH or niyojanaM. — (Power of nominating or appointing) niyojanADikAraH.
NOMINATIVE: kartA, n. case: kartfkArakam.
NOMINATIVE , s. (Case in grammar) karttA m. (rttf), karttfkArakaH, karttfvAcakaH, praTamA, praTamA viBaktiH.
NOMINATOR: (1) *nirvAcakaH;(2) nirvAcayitf (m.); (3) by verb.
NOMINATOR , s. niyojakaH, nAmanirdeSapUrvvaM niyojayitA m. (tf), nirdeSakaH.
NOMINEE: nirvAcitaH (tA, taM), he is Rājā's n.: rAjYA nirvAcitaH saH.
NOMINEE , s. niyojitaH, niyuktaH, aDikftaH.

Non, (a prefix) Ex. by a, an; ‘n(on)-acceptance’ aparigrahaH, asvIkAraH; ‘n(on)-appearance, n(on)-attendance’ anupasTiti f., asaMniDAnaM, adarSanaM, avidyamAnatA; ‘n(on)-attainment’ aprApti f., alABaH; ‘n(on)-attention’ anavaDAnaM, pramAdaH; ‘n(on)-chalant’ nirutsuka, anape(ve)kza, udAsIna, niHspfha; ‘n(on)-compliance’ ananuroDaH, ananuvartanaM, viroDaH; ‘n(on)-conductor’ avAhakraH, anA-yakaH; ‘n(on)-conformist’ ananuroDin m., ananuvartin; sAmAnyaDarmaviroDin m. matAMtaragrAhin m. ‘n(on)-comformity’ ananuroDaH, matAMtaragrahaRaM; ‘n(on)-descript’ avarRita, akftala-kzaRa; ‘n(on)-resistance’ apratIkAraH; &c. &c.
NON: prefix: expr. by a or an, before vowels, n.-enjoyment: amogaH, n.-arrival: anAgamaH.
NON . A prefix expressed in Sanskrit by a or an.
NON-ACCEPTANCE , s. aparigrahaH, agrahaRaM, apratigrahaH, asvIkAraH.
NON-APPEARANCE , s. adarSanaM, anupasTAnaM, anupasTitiH f., avidyamAnatA.
NON-ARRIVAL , s. anAgamaH -manaM, anaBigamanaM, anupasTAnaM.
NON-ATTAINMENT , s. aprAptiH f., alABaH, alabDiH f., anavAptiH f.
NON-ATTENDANCE: anupasTitiH: v. Attendance.
NON-ATTENDANCE , s. adarSanaM, darSanABAvaH, anupasTAnaM. See NON- APPEARANCE.
NON-ATTENTION , s. anavaDAnaM -natA, anavahitatvaM, alakzyaM.
NON-COMMENCEMENT , s. anAramBaH, anArabDiH f., anupakramaH.
NON-COMMISSIONED , a. anaDikAravAn -vatI -vat (t), apadayuktaH -ktA -ktaM.
NON-COMPLIANCE , s. ananuroDaH -DanaM, asvIkAraH, ananuvfttiH f.
NON-CONDUCTOR: apravAhakaH, n. of electricity: na taqitpravAhakaH.
NON-CONDUCTOR , NON-CONDUCTING, a. avAhakaH -kA -kaM, aprApakaH -kA -kaM, anAyakaH -kA -kaM, anetA -trI -tf (tf).

NON-CONFORMIST , s. ananuroDI m. (n), ananuvarttI m., ananusArI m., ananuyAyI m., ananukUlaH. — (Dissenter from the established church) deSasTApitaDarmmaviroDI m. (n), sADAraRaDarmmaviroDI m., deSasTApitaDarmmavisammataH, matAntarAvalambI m., matAntaragrAhI m., matAnta- raDArI m.
NON-CONFORMITY , s. ananuroDaH -DanaM, ananuvarttanaM, ananusaraRaM, asvIkAraH. — (Dissent) deSasTApitaDarmmaviroDaH, deSasTApitaDarmmAsammatiH f., matAnta- rAvalambanaM, matAntaraM.
NON-CONTACT , s. asparSaH, asamparkaH, aspfzwiH f., asaMsargaH.
NON-DELIVERY , s. asamarpaRaM, apratipAdanaM, apradAnaM, asampradAnaM.
NON-ELECT , a. avftaH -tA -taM, avfttaH -ttA -ttaM, anudDftaH -tA -taM.
NON-ENJOYMENT , s. aBogaH, asamBogaH, anupaBogaH, aBuktiH f.
NON-ESSENTIAL: anAvaSyakaH (kI, kaM) (= need- -less).
NON-EXISTENCE , s. aBAvaH, asamBavaH, asadBAvaH, nAstitvaM. See NONENTITY.
NON-EXISTENT , a. avarttamAnaH -nA -naM, avidyamAnaH -nA -naM, asan -satI -sat (t), asamBavaH -vA -vaM, asamBUtaH -tA -taM, aBUtaH -tA -taM, niHsattvaH -ttvA -ttvaM, aDriyamARaH -RA -RaM.
NON-OBSERVANCE , s. apAlanaM, apratipAlanaM, arakzaRaM, asevanaM.
NON-PAREIL , a. anupamaH -mA -maM, apratimaH &c., advitIyaH -yA -yaM.
NON-PERFORMANCE , s. ananuzWAnaM, aviDAnaM, akaraRaM, akarmma n. (n).
NON-PLUS , s. anupAyaH, agatiH f. -titvaM, nirupAyatvaM, gatihInatA, niru- ttaratvaM, anuttaratvaM, mohaH, vyastatA, kuRWatA.
To NON-PLUS , v. a. niruttarIkf, anuttarIkf, nirupAyIkf, gatihInaM -nAM kf, muh (c. 10. mohayati -yituM), vyAkulIkf.
NON-PLUSED , p. p. nirupAyaH -yA -yaM, gatihInaH -nA -naM, upAyahInaH, niruttaraH -rA -raM, anuttaraH &c., hftottaraH &c., kuRWitaH -tA -taM.
NON-RESIDENCE , s. avasatiH f., avAsaH, anivasanaM, anivAsaH, anavasTitiH f.
NON-RESIDENT: sTAnAntaravAsin (f. nI) and sim. comp.s.
NON-RESIDENT , a. avAsI -sinI -si(n), svasTAnAvAsI &c., anavasTitaH &c.
NON-RESISTANCE: apratiroDaH and sim. comp.s.
NON-RESISTANCE , s. apratIkAraH, apratikriyA, apratiroDaH, anivAraRaM.
NON-RESUMPTION , s. apunarAdAnaM, apunarharaRaM, anapakarmma n. (n).
NON-SOLUTION , s. alApanaM, avyAKyA -KyAnaM, apariSoDanaM, alApanikA.

NON-SUITED , p. p. avasannaH -nnA -nnaM, avasAditaH -tA -taM, hInaH -nA -naM, arTAdDInaH -nA -naM, hInavAdaH -dA -daM, nazwavAdaH -dA -daM, hatavAdaH; ‘to be non-suited,’ arTAd hA in pass. (hIyate), avasad (c. 1. -sIdati -sattuM), nazwavAdaH -dA -daM BU.
NON-SUPERINTENDENCE , s. anaDizWAnaM, anaDizWitiH f., anaDizWAtftvaM, anaDikAraH.
Nonage, s. bAlyaM, bAlyadaSA; See Minority.
NONAGE , s. bAlyaM, bAladaSA, vyavahArAyogyatA, aprAptavyavahAratvaM.
Nonagenarian, s. navativarzIyaH.
NONAGENARIAN , a. daSamI m. (n), daSamIsTaH, daSamINgataH.
Nonagon, s. navakoRAkfti f.
Nonce, s. avasaraH, kAlaH; ‘for the n(once)’ asminsamaye.
NONCE: “for the n.”: tatkAle.
NONCE , s. prayojanaM, avasaraH, vAraH, samayaH, upayogaH.
Nonchalance, s. OdAsInyaM, anapekzA.
NONCHALANCE: nirutsAhatAH: v. Indifference, carelessness.
NONCHALANCE , s. nirutsukatA, udAsInatA, jaqatA, anapekzA, anAsTA.
NONCHALANT , a. nirutsukaH -kA -kaM, udAsInaH -nA -naM, anapekzaH -kzA -kzaM, nirapekzaH &c., jaqaH -qA -qaM, anaBilAzaH -zA -zaM, niHspfhaH -hA -haM.
NONCONFORMIST: *matApalApin (f. nI).
NONCONFORMITY: *matApalApaH.
Nondescript, a. vicitra, aparUpa, vilakzaRa.
NONDESCRIPT: na vivftapUrvaH (rvA, rvaM): v. New, odd.
NONDESCRIPT , a. avarRitaH -tA -taM, avarRanIyaH -yA -yaM, alakzaRaH -RA -RaM.

None, a. na kaScit, na kopi, na kaScana, na kAcit, &c.; oft. ex. by na with other words; ‘n(one) other’ nAnya, netara; ‘n(one) but’ eva; (with compar. adj.) na kimapi, na Izadapi, na manAgapi, na stokamapi.

NONE: na ko'pi (f. kApi, n. kimapi) or kaScit (f. kAcit, n. kiYcit) or kaScana (f. kAcana, n. kiYcana), n. of his brothers: na kaYcana BrAtfzu, R. xiv. 43.; n. else: nAnyaH ko'pi. N. but: expr. by eva, n. but the brave: sAhasikA eva: v. Only. N. -so-pretty: a plant: kAntimatI.

NONE , a. na kaScit m., na kAcit f., na kiYcit n., na ko'pi, na kA f., na kimapi n., na kaScana m., na kAcana f., na kiYcana n., often ex- pressed by na with another word; as, ‘none other,’ nAnyaH -nyA -nyat. — (Not the least portion, not any, none at all) na kiYcidapi, na kimapi, na kiyadapi, na sUkzmamapi, na stokamapi, na leSamapi, na manAgapi, aleSaM, aleSamapi, alabaleSaM.
Nonentity, s. aBAvaH, asaMBavaH, asattA, asadBAvaH, SUnyatA. 2 SUnyaM, avastu n.; ‘he is a n(onentity) in the kingdom’ rAjye akiMci-tkaraH saH.
NONENTITY: (1) asat, there is nothing out of n.: nAsato vidyate BAvaH, G.;(2) aBAvaH, G.

NONENTITY , s. (Non-existence) aBAvaH, asamBavaH, aBavaH, asadBAvaH, asattvaM, asattA, nAstitvaM, nAsti ind., ajIvaH, ajIvitvaM, ajIvaniH f., avastutA -tvaM, avarttamAnatA, avfttitA, avidvyamAnatA, SUnyatA. — (A non- entity) apadArTaH, asatpadArTaH, alIkapadArTaH, azastu n., asadvastu n., asamBavaM, SUnyaM.
NONES: in Roman calendar: *navamaH.
NONES , s. pl. romIyapaYjikAyAM mAsasya paYcamo or saptamo divasaH.
NONESSENTIAL , a. anAvaSyakaH -kI -kaM, karttavyAkarttavyaH -vyA -vyaM, kAryyA- kAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, kftAkftaH -tA -taM, anAntarIyakaH -kA -kaM.
None-such, s. nirupamaM or advitIyaM vastu n.
NONEXISTENCE: nAstitvam: v. Existence.
Nonfeasance, s. akarman n.
NONJUROR: navarAjyavidvezin (f. RI).
Nonpareil, a. apratima, anupama, advitIya.
NONPAREIL: (1) apratimaH (mA, maM);(2) anupamaH (mA, maM).
Nonplus, v. i. kuMW 10, vi-, muh c., Aku-lIkf 8 U, niruttarIkf. s. kuMWatA, vi-, mohaH, niruttaratA, agati f., nirupAyatA. [Nonplus]ed, a. kuMWita, nirupAya, gatihIna, agatika, mUQa, niruttara.
NONPLUS (v.): mohayati, vi-, (c. of muh): v. To confound.

Nonsense, s. asaMbadDa-anarTaka-vAkyaM-vacanaM-BAzaRaM, mfzAkaTA-AlApaH, pralApaH, jalpitaM, asatyaM, ayATArTyaM, anarTakaM; ‘to talk n(onsense)’ pralap 1 P, prajalp 1 P, asaMbadDaM BAz 1 A; ‘talking n(onsense)’ asaMbadDapralApin, vAcAla, jalpaka. Nonsensical, a. asaM-badDa, asaMgata, anarTaka, nirarTaka, mfzArTaka, ayaTArTa. [Nonsensical]ly, adv. anarTakaM, asaMbadDaM, asaM-gataM, mfzA, vfTA. [Nonsensical]ness, s. asaMbadDatA, &c.
NONSENSE: I Subs.: expr. by adj., talking n.: asambadDapralApin (f. nI), Sa. i.II As ex- -clam.: Dik prahasanam, U. iv.

NONSENSE , s. anarTakaM, AnarTakyaM, anarTakavAkyaM, anarTakaBAzaRaM, nirarTa- kavAkyaM, abadDaM, asambadDaM, abaDyaM, asambadDavAkyaM, anivadDavAkyaM, asamba- dDakaTA, vfTAkaTA, mfzArTakaM, ayATArTyaM, jalpitaM, pralapitaM, pralApaH, anarTaH, arTahInavacanaM; ‘talking nonsense,’ asambadDapralApI -pinI -pi (n), anibadDapralApI &c., anarTakavaktA -ktrI -ktf (ktf), jalpakaH -kA -kaM, jalpAkaH -kA -kaM, vAcAlaH -lA -laM, vAcAwaH -wA -waM, bahugarhya- vAk m. f. n.
NONSENSICAL: (1) nirarTakaH (kA, kaM) (without sense);(2) asambadDa (f. dDA) (= inconsistent, improper);(3) mfzArTakaH (kA, kaM).

NONSENSICAL , a. anarTakaH -kA -kaM, nirarTakaH -kA -kaM, anarTaH -rTA -rTaM, arTahInaH -nA -naM, arTaSUnyaH -nyA -nyaM, arTarahitaH -tA -taM, mfzArTakaH &c., vfTArTakaH &c., asambadDaH -dDA -dDaM, asambadDArTaH -rTA -rTaM, abadDaH &c., anibadDaH &c., asaNgataH -tA -taM, ayaTArTaH -rTA -rTaM, ayuktikaH -kA -kaM, aBiDeyarahitaH -tA -taM.
NONSENSICALLY , adv. nirarTakaM, sAnarTakyaM, asambadDaM, vfTA, mfzA.
NONSENSICALNESS , s. anarTakatA, nirarTakatA, AnarTakyaM, arTahInatA, arTABAvaH, asaNgatatA, asambadDatA, ayATArTyaM, ayuktiH f.
NONSUIT (v.): to be n.ed: arTAt hIyate (pass. of hA).
Nonsuited, a. nazwa-hIna-vAda, avasanna, arTAd hIna; ‘to be n(onsuited)’ avasad 1 P, arTAt-vAdAd hA pass.
Noodle, s. mUQaH, mUrKaH, alpaDIH, jaqamatiH.
NOODLE: alpabudDi (mfn.): v. Simpleton, block- -head.
NOODLE , s. alpabudDiH m., alpaDIH m., mUrKaH, jaqaDIH m.
Nook, s. koRaH, asraH; viviktasTAnaM.
NOOK: (1) koRaH (= corner: q.v.);(2) viviktam (= secluded retreat).
NOOK , s. koRaH, asraH, AraM, viviktasTAnaM, guptasTAnaM.
Noon, s. (‘N(oon)-time’) maDyAhnaH, maDyadinaM, maDyAhnakAlaH. a. mADyAhnika (kI f.), mADyaMdina (nI f.).
NOON: (1) maDyAhnaH;(2) maDyandinam;(3) dina- yOvanam (poet.), R.
NOON , NOON-DAY, NOON-TIDE, s. maDyAhnaH, maDyAhnakAlaH, dinamaDyaM, diva- samaDyaM, divAmaDyaM, maDyandinaM, uddinaM.
NOON , NOON-DAY, a. mADyAhnikaH -kI -kaM, mADyandinaH -nI -naM.
NOONDAY: mADyAhnikaH (kI, kaM): v. Midday.
NOONTIDE: (1) maDyAhnavelA;(2) maDyAhnakAlaH; etc.
Noose, s. pASaH, vAgurA, baMDanaM; See Snare; ‘n(oose) for the neck’ kaMWapASaH. v. t. pASena baMD 9 P, pASe grah 9 U or pat c.
NOOSE (subs.): pASaH, to cut (i. e. remove) n.s.: pASAn Cinatti, H.: v. Halter, snare.
NOOSE (v. t.): pASe pAtayati (c. of pat): v. To ensnare.
NOOSE , s. pASaH, pASabanDaH -nDaM -nDanaM, vAgurA, unmATaH, kUwapASaH; ‘for the neck,’ galapASaH; ‘number of nooses,’ pASyA.
To NOOSE , v. a. pASa (nom. pASayati -yituM), pASIkf, pASena banD (c. 9. baDnAti, bandDuM), pASe or unmATe pat (c. 10. pAtayati -yituM).
NOOSED , p. p. pASitaH -tA -taM, pASIkftaH &c., pASabadDaH -dDA -dDaM.
Nor, conj. na ca, na vA; See Neither.
NOR: na..na ca: v. Neither, not.
NOR . adv. na, na ca, sometimes expressed by the prohibitive mA, or sometimes simply by vA in conjunction with a negative. See NEITHER, conj.
Norm, s. AdarSaH, nidarSanaM. 2 viDiH, niyamaH, sUtraM. [Norm]al, a. yaTAkramaM, vEDika (kI f.). 2 vidyAraMBaSikzaka.
NORMAL: yuktaH (ktA, ktaM) (?): v. Regular. N. school: *SikzakaSikzAniveSaH.

NORMAL , a. (Regular) vEDikaH -kI -kaM, yaTAviDiH -DiH -Di, yaTAkramaH -mA -maM. — (Relating to rudiments, teaching rudiments) mUlavidyAsambanDI -nDinI &c., vidyopakramasambanDI &c., vidyAramBopadeSakaH -kA -kaM, mUlavidyASikzakaH -kA -kaM.

North, s. uttarA, udIcI, uttaradiS-diSA, uttarASA, kOberI; ‘to the n(orth)’ uttaraM (with abl.), uttarataH (with gen.); ‘facing the n(orth)’ udaNmuKa a. (KI f.). [North]erly, [North]ern, a. uttara, udIcIna, uttara-sTa, udIcya, udac; ‘in a n(ortherly) direction’ uttareRa (with acc. or gen.); ‘n(orth)-east’ uttarapUrvA, pUrvottarA, ESAnI, prAguttarA, prAgudIcI; (a.; (north-east)erly, (north-east)ern), prAguttara, pUrvottara, prAgudIcIna; pUrvottarasTa; ‘n(orth)-pole’, ‘n(orth)-star’ DruvaH; ‘n(orth)-west’ uttarapaScimA, vAyavI; (a.; (north-west)erly, (north-west)ern) vAyava, vAyudiksTa. [North]ward, a. uttara, uttaradiksTa. [North]wards, adv. uttarABimuKaM, uttarataH, uttareRa, uttara-diSi.

NORTH (subs.): (1) uttarA diS (f.); uttarASA (f.); etc., on the n.: uttarasyAM diSi, K.; to the n.: uttarataH, V. m.; to the n. of Kuvera's dwelling: DanapatigfhAnuttareRa, Me. ii. 14.;(2) udicI, fac- ing the n.: udaNmuKa (f. KI), V. m.;(3) kOverI diS, etc., from the n.: kOveryAH kakuBaH, Vi.; (4) (poet.) kuveraguptA-, Ku.; DanadapAlitA-, Mah.; saptarzitArASabalA-, K., diS.

NORTH (adj.): uttaraH (rA, raM), the n. Kurus: uttarAn kurUn, Ki.; what is n. of the ocean: uttaraM yat samudrasya, V. p.; n. wind: uttaro vAyuH, V. m.; (rarely) udIcInaH (nA, naM) or udIcya (f. cyA) or kOveraH (rI, raM), the n. quarter: kOveradigBAgaH, Si. N. star.: DruvaH.
NORTH , s. uttarA, uttaradik f. (S), uttaradiSA, uttarASA, udIcI, kOverI, sOmyA. Kuvera, according to the Hindūs, is the Regent of the North.
NORTH , a. uttaraH -rA -raM, uttarasTaH -sTA -sTaM, udIcInaH -nA -naM, udaN -dIcI -dak (Yc), kOveraH -rI -raM; ‘north-road,’ uttarApaTaH; ‘north- country,’ udIcyaH.

NORTH-EAST: I Adj.:(1) pUrvottaraH (rA, raM), the n. wind: pUrvottaro vAyuH, Mah.; to the n. of Kailāsa: prAguttareRa kElAsAt, Mat.;(2) uttarapUrvaH (rvA, rvaM);(3) prAgudIcya (f. cyA) or -cInaH (nA, naM).II Subs.:(1) pUrvottarA or uttarapUrvA or ESAnI diS (f.), towards the n.: ESAnIM diSaM prati, V.;(2) pUrvottaro digBAgaH, to the n. of the mount Kailāsa: kElAsaSiKariRaH pUrvottare digBAge, R.;(3) prAgudIcI.
NORTH-EAST , s. prAguttarA, prAgudIcI, pUrvvottaraM -rA, ESAnI, aparAjitA; ‘north-eastwards,’ prAguttareRa, pUrvvottareRa; ‘north-east of the city,’ prAguttareRa nagarAt.

NORTH-EAST , NORTH-EASTERLY, NORTH-EASTERN, a. prAguttaraH -rA -raM, [Page536-b+ 51] pUrvvottaraH -rA -raM, prAgudaN -dIcI -dak (Yc), prAgudIcInaH -nA -naM, prAguttarasTaH -sTA -sTaM, pUrvvottarasTaH &c.
NORTH-POLE , NORTH-STAR, s. DruvaH, meruH m., OttAnapAdiH m.
NORTH-WEST (subs.): paScimottarA or uttarapaScimA or vAyavI dik, ASA, etc.
NORTH-WEST, NORTH-WESTERLY, NORTH-WESTERN: (1) paScimottaraH (rA, raM);(2) vAyavya (f. vyA) (rare) (of the n. wind), V. m.
NORTH-WEST , s. vAyavI, vAyukoRaH, vAyudiSA.
NORTH-WEST , NORTH-WESTERLY, NORTH-WESTERN, a. vAyukoRasTaH -sTA -sTaM, vAyudiksTaH &c., vAyavaH -vI -vaM, vAyavIsambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n).
NORTH-WIND , s. uttaravAyuH m., uttaradigvAyuH m., uttaradikpavanaH.
NORTHERLY (adv.): I Northwards: q. v.: II From the north: uttarataH.
NORTHERLY, NORTHERN (adj.): uttaraH (rA, raM) v. North. N. lights: *uttaraprakASaH: v. Aurora borealis. N.-most: sarvottaraH (rA, raM).
NORTHERLY , NORTHERN, a. uttaradiSyaH -SyA -SyaM, uttaraH -rA -raM, udI- cInaH -nA -naM, uttarasambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n); ‘in a northerly direction,’ uttaradiSi.
NORTHWARD , a. uttaradiSyaH -SyA -SyaM, uttaradiksTaH -sTA -sTaM, udaNmuKaH -KI -KaM, uttarasTaH -sTA -sTaM.
NORTHWARDS: uttarABimuKam; uttarAM diSaM prati and sim. comp.s.
NORTHWARDS , adv. uttareRa -rAt, uttaratas, uttaradiSi, uttaratra.

Nose, s. nAsA, nAsikA, GrARaM, GoRA, nasA, nasyA, gaMDavahA, gaMDajYA; ‘led by the n(ose)’ nasyota, nastita; (fig.) yaTecCaM kfzwa, svecCayA nIta; ‘aquiline n(ose)’ SukanAsA; ‘having a sharp n(ose)’ KaraRas, KaraRasa; ‘having a hoof-like n(ose)’ KuraRas, Kura-Rasa; ‘having a flat n(ose)’ natanAsika; See under Flat; ‘having a prominent n(ose)’ pralaMbaGoRa, GoRonnata; ‘breathing through the n(ose)’ nAsikaMDama; ‘n(ose)-string’ nAsyaM; ‘n(ose)-cut’ CinnanAsa; ‘n(ose)-gay’ kusumastabakaH, puzpagucCaH, gucCaH, gutsaH; ‘n(ose)-ring’ nAsA-BaraRaM. [Nose]less, a. a-vi-nAsika, vigra, viKra, viKya, gatanAsika. Nostril, s. nAsAraMDraM-vivaraM-CidraM-puwaM-bilaM.

NOSE (subs.): (1) nAsA or nAsikA, through the n.: nAsikayA, N.; tip of the n.: nAsAgram, J.; diseases of the n.: nAsArogAH, Sr.; running of the n.: nAsAparisrAvaH, Sr.; n.-string: (for cattle): nAsyam;(2) nAsikyam (rare);(3) GrARam (poet.), with a long elevated bridge of the n.: AyatottuNgaGrARavaMSa (f. SA), K. To lead by the n.: yaTecCaM vAhayati (?). To thrust one's n. into: anyAyacarcAM karoti (?).

NOSE , s. nAsA -sikA, nasA, nasyA, GrARaM, GoRA, ganDavahA, ganDavAhaH, ganDajYA, ganDanAlI, GratiH f., nAH f. (s), nastaH, nAsikyaM, nAsikyakaM, siNGinI, vikURikA, tanuBastrA, nakraM, nakuwaM, narkuwakaM; ‘aquiline nose,’ SukanAsikA; ‘having a sharp nose,’ svaraRasaH -sA -saM, svaraRAH -RAH -RaH (s); ‘having a nose like a hoof,’ KuraRasaH -sA -saM, svuraRAH -RAH -RaH (s); ‘having a flat nose,’ natanAsikaH -kA -kaM, avawIwaH -wA -waM, avanAwaH -wA -waM, avaBrawaH -wA -waM; ‘having a prominent nose,’ pralambaGoRaH -RA -RaM; ‘having a large nose,’ ugranAsikaH -kA -kaM; ‘tip of the nose,’ nAsikAgraM, nAsAgraM; ‘mucus of the nose,’ nAsikAmalaM; ‘running at the nose,’ nAsikAsrAvaH, nAsAparisrAvaH; ‘thickening of the membrane of the nose, nAsAnAhaH; ‘dryness of the nose,’ nAsASozaH; ‘breathing through the nose,’ nAsikanDamaH -mA -maM; ‘drinking through the nose,’ nAsikanDayaH -yI -yaM; ‘led by the nose, as cattle, &c. nastitaH, nastotaH, nasyotaH.
NOSE-BRIDLE , s. (Rein passed through the nose of an ox) nAsyaM, nAsikArajjuH m. f.
NOSE-CUT , a. CinnanAsaH -sA -saM, CinnanAsikaH -kA -kaM, CinnanAH -nAH -naH (s),
NOSEGAY: (1) kusumastavakaH;(2) puzpagucCaH;(3) prasUnaprakAraH (rare).
NOSEGAY , s. kusumastavakaH, puzpastavakaH, puzpagucCaH -cCakaH, gucCaH -cCakaH, gutsaH -tsakaH, guYjaH, guluYCaH, samAlI, kuwI, prakaraH.

NOSELESS , a. anAsikaH -kA -kaM, vinAsikaH -kA -kaM, vinasaH -sA -saM, gatanAsikaH -kA -kaM, nirnAsikaH &c., nAsikAhInaH -nA -naM, nAsi- kASUnyaH -nyA -nyaM, viKaH -KA -KaM, viKuH -KuH -Ku, viKyaH -KyA -KyaM, viKraH &c., viKruH &c., vigraH -grA -graM.
Nosology, s. roganidAnaSAstraM.
NOSOLOGY: rogavijYAnam, Sr.
NOSOLOGY , s. roganidAnaSAstraM, nidAnavidvyA, rogavargakaraRavidvyA.
NOSOPOETIC , a. rogakaraH -rA -raM, vyADijanakaH -kA -kaM, rogotpAdakaH &c.
NOSTRIL: (1) nAsAranGram;(2) nAsAkuharam;(3) nAsAvivaram.
NOSTRIL , s. nAsAranDraM, nAsikAranDraM, nAsAgraranDraM, nAsAvivaraM, nAsikACidraM, nAsApuwaM, nAsAvilaM; ‘air breathed through the nostrils,’ svaraH.
Nostrum, s. guptOzaDaM.
NOSTRUM: miTyOzaDam; guptOzaDam (?), etc.
NOSTRUM , s. gUQOzaDaM, guptOzaDaM, aprakASitOzaDaM, miTyOzaDaM.

details.body: Not, adv. na, no, na hi. 2 (Prohibitive) mA; oft. by alaM with instr. or gerund; ‘do n(ot) fear’ alaM Bayena, mA BEzIH; ‘do n(ot) boast much’ alamalaM bahu vikaTya (M. 1); ‘do n(ot) do so’, ‘do n(ot) say so’ mA mA evaM; (rather angrily) mA tAvat. 3 (Privative) a, nir, an, vi pr.

NOT: (1) na, there the sun does n. shine, the [Page476] moon does n. gleam: na tatra sUryastapati na virAjati candramAH, Mat.; (it is) lightning n. my darling Urvaśī.. vidyut, priyA mama norvaSI, V.; there was n. a (single) prince of high birth who did n. go: nAsIdagantA kulajaH kumAraH, N.x. 2.; n. that he was n. beautiful nor that she did n. know to see well: nAsO na kAmyo na ca veda samyag drazwuM na sA, R. vi. 30.; n. so much.. as: na taTA.. yaTA, Ki. xiii. 32.; n. only with (their) hearts: na kevalaM hfdayena, N. xi. 2.; n. even death can strike on me: praBuH prahartuM mayi nAntako'pi, R. ii. 62.; for .. n. : nahiH : v. For;(2) mA (prohibitive), do n. boast of wealth, men or youth: mA kurU DanajanayOvanagarvam, J.; let n. your sense-horses carry you astray: mA BUvannapaTaharAstavendriyASvAH, Ki. v. 50.;(3) a-, (an-, before vowels) or nir-, in comp., n. able: aSakta (f. ktA); n. kind: nirdayaH (yA, yaM); there is nothing mine which is n. yours: aBavadIyaM nEva kiYcinmatsambadDam, D.

NOT , adv. In absolute negation, denial, or refusal, ‘not’ is rendered by na, no, nA, nahi. When prohibitive, by mA, mAsma, or sometimes by alaM or kftaM with instr. c. When privative, it is expressed by a, an, nir, vi prefixed; as, ‘there is not,’ nAsti; ‘he will not go,’ na gamizyati; ‘do not go,’ mA gacCa; ‘do not grieve,’ alaM Sokena; ‘not regardful,’ anapekzaH -kzA -kzaM, nirapekzaH &c.; ‘not at all,’ aleSaM, na kiYcidapi; ‘not so,’ mEvaM. In prohibitive phrases mA [Page537-a+ 51] may be used with the 3d pret., the augment being cut off; as, ‘do not grieve’ mA'SocIH; ‘do not fear,’ mA'BEzIH. The interrogative ‘is not?’ is rendered by nanu.

NOTABLY: viSezeRa (= specially): v. Also remarkably.
NOTABLY , adv. prasidDaM, lokaprasidDaM, smaraRIyaM, viSizwaprakAreRa.
NOTARY: leKakapramARakaH.
NOTARY , s. kAyasTaH, leKakaH, lipikAraH, lipijIvI m. (n), leKyapa- trapramAtA m. (tf), patrapramARajIvI.

Note, s. liMgaM, lakzaRaM, cihnaM, aMkaH; aBijYAnaM. 2 smaraRacihnaM, smaraRaM. 3 wIkA, vyAKyA, BAzyaM, wippanI, vftti f.; ‘edited with n(ote)s’ wippanIsamavetaM prakASitaM (pustakaM). 4 svaraH, kvaRaH; ‘a wrong n(ote)’ apa-vi-svaraH; ‘high n(ote)’ tAraH, tArasvaraH; ‘cracked n(ote)’ kAkasvaraH; ‘key-n(ote)’ vAdin m.; (the seven n(ote)s being nizAdaH, fzaBaH, gAMDAraH, zaqjaH, maDyamaH, DEvataH, paMcamaH); ‘sweet n(ote)’ kAkalI; ‘sweet indistinct n(ote)’ kalaH; ‘deep n(ote)’ maMdraH; ‘continued n(ote)’ ekatAlaH. 5 KyAti f., kIrti f., yaSas n., pratizWA. ‘of n(ote)’ viSruta, labDakIrti-pratizWa. 6 vi-, rutaM, rAvaH, nAdaH, svanaH, SabdaH, DvaniH. 7 avekzA, avaDAnaM, manoyogaH, aBiniveSaH; ‘take n(ote) of’ avekz 1 A, avaDA 3 U, manasi-citte-kf 8 U, avaDf 10. 8 patraM, patrakaM, leKaH, leKyaM; ‘n(ote)-book’ smaraRa-aMkana-pustakaM; ‘n(ote)-worthy’ smaraRIya, smaraRArha, avekzaRIya. v. t. nirvarR 10, Alakz 10, nirUp 10, avekz, Aloc 10, Alok 1 A, 10. 2 liK 6 P, (leKye) Aruh c. (ropayati), (patre) niviS c. 3 aMk 10, cihnayati (D.). [Not]able, a. smaraRIya, smaraRArha, smartavya. 2 viSizwa, utkfzwa, parama; KyAta, prasidDa, viSeza in comp.; ‘a n(otable) guest’ atiTiviSezaH. s. kulIna-viSizwa-janaH, AryaH; See Noble. [Not]ably, adv. prasidDaM, viSezeRa, viSezataH. [Not]ary, s. leKakaH, lipikAraH, lipijIvin m. [Not]ation, aMkanaM, aMkavidyA. [Not]ed, a. lakzita, nirUpita, liKita, patrArUQa. 2 pra-vi-KyAta, suviSruta, prasidDa, labDapratizWa, praTita.

NOTE (subs.): I A mark: liNgam.II A sign: saMjYA.III A memorandum: no equiv.: sAraleKaH.IV Explanatory:(1) wIkA;(2) vyAKyA.V A short letter: patrikA.VI Musi- -cal symbol: cihnam,.VII Musical tone: svaraH.VIII Reputation: of n.: viSrutaH (tA, taM),: v. Renowned, famous.IX Heed: take n. of: avekzate.X Of birds: rUtam. XI Commercial: patram (when the sense is clear). Promissory n.: *pratijYApatram.
NOTE (v.): I To observe, remark: q. v.: varRayati, nir-, (varR, c. 10.).II To record, write: q. v.: liKati (liK, c. 6.).III To charge. stigmatize: aBiSaMsati (SaMs, c. 1.).

NOTE , s. (Mark, token) cihnaM, lakzaRaM, aNkaH -NkaM, lAYCanaM, aBijYAnaM, lakzyaM, kalaNkaH. — (Mark made as a memorandum) smaraRArTa- kacihnaM, smaraRacihnaM, smaraRaM. — (Annotation, comment) wIkA, BAzyaM, vyAKyA, wizyanI, vArttikaM; ‘with notes,’ sawIkaH -kA -kaM. — (Sound in music) svaraH, mAtfkA, mUrcCanA, kaWaH, kvaRaH, viribDaH, virAvaH; ‘a false note,’ apasvaraH, visvaraH, apakvaRaH; ‘a high note,’ tAraH; ‘a cracked note,’ kAkasvaraH; ‘key note,’ vAdI m. (n). The notes in music are nizAdaH or nizadaH or nizaDaH, fzaBaH, gAnDAraH, zaqjaH, maDyamaH, paYcamaH, DEvataH, GarGaraH. — (Note of birds) rutaM, vASitaM, vASanaM. — (Notice, heed) avekzA -kzaRaM, apekzA, manoyogaH, lakzaM -kzyaM. — (Reputation) kIrttiH f., KyAtiH f., pratizWA, yaSas n., gOravaM; ‘of little note,’ alpakIrttiH -rttiH -rtti, alpi- zWakIrttiH &c. See NOTED. (Short letter) patrakaM, patraM, leKaH, leKyaM. — (Note of hand) patraleKyaM.

To NOTE , v. a. (Observe) lakz (c. 10. lakzayati -yituM), Alakz, upalakz, avekz (c. 1. -Ikzate -kzituM), apekz, avekzAM kf, Alok (c. 10. -lokayati -yituM), nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM), Aloc (c. 10. -loca- yati -yituM), AlocanaM kf. — (Set down in writing, make a note of) aNk (c. 10. aNkayati -yituM), cihn (c. 10. cihnayati -yituM), smaraRArTakacihnaM kf, smaraRapustake or leKyapatre samAruh in caus. (-ropa- yati -yituM) or Aruh, aBiliK (c. 6. -liKati -leKituM).
NOTE-BOOK: *sAraleKabanDaH; smaraRapatrikA.
NOTE-BOOK , s. smaraRapustakaM, smArakapustakaM, aNkanapustakaM.
NOTED: i. e. celebrated: q. v.: prasidDa (f. dDA).

NOTED , p. p. or a. (Observed) lakzitaH -tA -taM, AlakzitaH &c., upalakzitaH &c., avekzitaH &c. — (Set down in writing) leKyArUQaH -QA -QaM, leKyAropitaH -tA -taM, smaraRapustakAropitaH &c. — (Celebrated) prasidDaH -dDA -dDaM, KyAtaH -tA -taM, viKyAtaH &c. praTitaH -tA -taM, viSrutaH -tA -taM, labDaSabdaH -bdA -bdaM, labDapratizWaH -zWA -zWaM.
NOTEWORTHY: expr. with parigrahItavya (f. vyA); avekzaRIyaH (yA, yaM); etc.

Nothing, s. aBAvaH, SUnyaM, asat n., avastu n., asattvaM. 2 na kiMcit, na kimapi, na stokamapi. 3 alpa-laGu-vizayaH, alpArTaH, agurvarTaH; ‘for n(othing)’ akAraRaM, animittaM, vfTA, muDA, nirarTakaM; ‘good for n(othing)’ vyarTa, nirarTaka, akiMcitkara (rI f.); ‘n(othing) but’ nAnyat kimapi (with abl.). adv. na manAgapi, na kiMcidapi, na stokamapi, na manAk, na kimapi. [Nothing]ness, s. aBAvaH, SUnyatA.

NOTHING (subs.): I Non-entity:(1) aBAvaH; (2) asat, there is n. out of n.: nAsato vidyate BAvaH, G.;(3) SUnyam, San.II Not anything: (1) na kiYcit, for there is n. which he cannot do from shame: na hi kiYcinna kriyate hriyA, K.; beyond which there is n. else: yasmAtparaM kiYcidanyannAsti, S. iii. 13.; it ts n. to Rāvaṇa: daSakanDaramaDikftya na kiYcidetat, An. vi.; said n., only with the feet.. na kiYcidUce caraRena kevalaM.., Ki. viii. 14.;(2) na kiYcana (rare), Mah. For n.: (a) without any cause: akAraRam; akAraRe; akARqe; avastuni (rare), Ra. iv.; (b) in vain: q. v.: vfTA. N. but: (= only: q.v.): nAnyat kiYcit (with abl.). To make n. of: na kiYcit manyate.
NOTHING (adv.): kiYcidapi or manAgapi.. na or a- in comp.

NOTHING , s. (Not any thing) na kiYcit, na kimapi, na kiYcana. — (Not any thing at all) na kiYcidapi, aleSamapi, na kiyadapi, na sUkzmamapi, na stokamapi. — (Non-existence, nonentity) aBAvaH, nAstitvaM, nAsti indec. asattvaM, avastu n., avastutA, SUnyatA -tvaM, SUnyaM, asamBavaH, avidyamAnatA. — (Trifle, thing of no value) alpavizayaH, svalpavizayaH, sulaGuvizayaH, alpArTavizayaH; ‘good for nothing,’ vyarTaH -rTA -rTaM, nirarTakaH -kA -kaM, kimarTaH -rTA -rTaM, akiYcitkaraH -rA -raM.
NOTHING , adv. na kiYcit, na kimapi, na kiYcidapi, na kiYcana, aleSa- mapi, aleSam, na kiyadapi, na manAgapi, na manAk, asUkzmamapi, astokamapi.
NOTHINGNESS: (1) aBAvatA;(2) SUnyatvam, San.
NOTHINGNESS , s. SUnyatA, SUnyaM, avastutvaM, nAstitvaM, aBAvaH. See NONENTITY.

NOTICE (v.): I To observe, see: lakzayati, A-, saM, aBi-, samA- (lakz, c. 10.), did not n.: nAlakzayat, Ku. iii. 51.II To remark upon: vivfRoti (vf, c. 5.) (= to explain): nirdiSati (diS, c. 6.)

NOTICE (subs.): I Heed, observation: (a) to take n. of: v. Notice (v) (I); (b) to attract n.: mano harati or Akarzati (kfz, c. 1.); (c) to escape n., expr. with lakzayati and na; (d) worthy of n., expr. by circumlo.: v. Note- -worthy.II Information, intelligence: q. v.: vijYApanam, to give n.: vijYApayati (c. of jYA). III Allusion, mention: ulleKaH; nirdeSaH.IV Notification:(1) vijYApanam (?);(2) GozaRA (= proclamation).V Attention: AdaraH. VI With a view to punishing: I will take n. of your conduct: perh. cezwitaM te smarizyAmi: v. Also chastise.

NOTICE , s. Notion, s. mati f., budDi f., boDaH, manogataM, mataM, kalpanA, BAvaH, aBiprAyaH, BAvanA, ASayaH, vAsanA; ‘under the n(otion) that’ iti budDyA. [Notion]al, a. manaH-sfzwa, manogata, manaHkalpita, saMkalpaja; See Ideal.
NOTION: I Conception: BAvaH.II Idea: q. v.: budDiH.III Opinion, belief: q. v.: viSvAsaH.

NOTORIETY: (1) prasidDiH;(2) durnAman (n.) (= bad name).

NOTORIOUSNESS: (1) prasidDatA;(2) prakASatA: v. Notoriety.

Notwithstanding, part. taTApi, tadapi, evaM satyapi; gen. ex. by gen. or loc. abs. or by anAdftya (with acc.); ‘n(otwithstanding) his teacherʼs presence’ vidyamAnepi gurO; See ‘In spite of’ under Spite.

Noun, s. nAman n., viSezyaM, sup, vAcakaH.

Now, adv. aDunA, idAnIM, saMprati, sAMprataM, prastuta-vartamAna-kAle, ihasamaye. 2 aTa, aTAtaH, ataHparaM, ataH; ‘n(ow)-n(ow)’ kvaMcit-kvacit, kadAci-t-kadAcit, aMtarA-aMtarA, (aMtarA pitfsakta-maMtarA mAtfsaMbaMDamAlApaM kurvan Ka. 118); ‘n(ow) and then’ kAle kAle, kadAcit, kadApi; ‘till n(ow)’ adya yAvat; ‘from n(ow)’ adyAraBya, adya praBfti, ataHparaM; ‘just n(ow)’ aDunEva, acirAt, idAnImeva; ‘n(ow)-a-days’ ezu divasezu, saMprati, aDunAtanakAle; ‘n(ow)-adays people’ idAnIMtanA-ADunikA-janAH.

NOW: I At the present time:(1) idAnIm, just n.: idAnImeba; enmity of n.: idAnIntanaM vEram, A. r.;(2) samprati or sAmpratam, but n. my only wish is: sAmprataM punarmama manoraTa eza eva, Ma.;(3) aDunA, where are you going now: kvAGunA gamyate, Vi.;(4) adya (= today), even n.: adyApi, U. i.II As correl.; now.. now:(1) antarA . antarA (= at intervals), conversing n. about his father, n. about his mother, n. about Śukanāsa: antarA pitfsaktamantarA mAtfsambadDamantarA SukanAsamayaM kurvannAlApam, K.;(2) kadAcit . kadAcit (= at one time . at another time), K.; (3) kvacit . kvacit (= 2), n. (in the region) of the clouds and n. of birds: kvacidGanAnAM patatAM kvacicca, R.III. As particle of transition:(1) aTa (or commonly) aTAtaH, n. we will describe penances: aTAto prAyaScittAni vyAKyAsyAmaH, At.; (2) ataH param or ata UrdDam (= after this), n. I will tell you: ataH paraM.. yuzmAkaM sampravakzyAmi, Pa.;(3) idAnIm, it n. remains: idamidAnImavaSizwam, S. iv. i.; (4) samprati, S. iv. = but: q.v.: tu “n. Barab- bas was a robber”: barabbAstu dasyurAsIt. Ph.: n. and then:(1) samaye samaye (= at times);(2) kadAcit: v. Sometimes; n. and n.: tadA tadA, D. iii.

(sTApayati); oft. ex. by saMKyA in comp.; ‘the enemyʼs force n(umber)ed 500’ paMcaSatasaMKyaM SatrusEnyaM. [Number]er, s. gaRakaH, saMKyAkft m. [Number]ing, s. gaRanaM-nA, saMKyAnaM. IV In pl., poetry, metre: q. v.: Candas (n.). V In. pl., the book of n.s: *saMKyADyAyaH.

III To reckon as one of a n.:(1) saMKyAti; (2) expr. by saMKyA, or to n. above men: manuzya- saMKyAmativartituM vA, Ki. iii, 40.IV To amount to: expr. by saMKyA, n.ing five thousand: paYca- sahasrasaMKya (f. KyA), -ka (f. -kA).

NUMBER , s. saMKyA. — (Assemblage of two or more units) rASiH m., saMKyA; ‘even number,’ samasaMKyA; ‘odd,’ vizamasaMKyA; ‘whole number,’ aBinnaM; ‘five in number,’ paYcasaMKyaH -KyA -KyaM, paYcasaMKyakaH -kA -kaM. — (Amount) saMKyA, gaRanA, parigaRanA, samudAyaH, parimARaM. — (Multitude, collection) gaRaH, samUhaH, samavAyaH, saNGaH, saNGAtaH, saYcayaH, vfndaM, saNgrahaH, stomaH, rASiH m., puYjaH, pUgaH; ‘a number of young women,’ taruRIgaRaH; ‘a number of men,’ puruzasamUhaH, puruzasamavAyaH. — (A great number, many) bAhulyaM, bahutvaM, bahuH -huH -hvI -hu, bahulaH -lA -laM, bahusaMKyakaH -kA -kaM, anekaH &c., pracuraH -rA -raM; ‘in great number,’ bahuSas, anekaSas. — (Figure, arithmetical sign) aNkaH, saMKyA. — (Science of numbers) aNkavidyA, gaRanAvidyA, gaRitaM, vyaktaM; ‘table of num- bers,’ aNkapatraM, aNkajAlaM, sAraRI. — (Verse) padyaM, Candas n., kavitA, padyaracanA. — (In grammar) vacanaM; ‘singular number,’ ekavacanaM; ‘dual,’ dvivacanaM; ‘plural,’ bahuvacanaM, anekavacanaM.

To NUMBER , v. a. (Count) saMKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM), parisaMKyA, sampariKyA, gaR (c. 10. gaRayati -yituM), vigaR, pragaR, aNk (c. 10. aNkayati -yituM), kal (c. 10. kalayati -yituM), gaRanAM kf, gaRIkf. — (Affix a number) aNk, aNkaM sTA in caus. (sTApayati -yituM) or liK (c. 6. liKati, leKituM).
NUMBERED , p. p. saMKyAtaH -tA -taM, gaRitaH -tA -taM, aNkitaH &c., kalitaH &c., gaRIBUtaH -tA -taM, gaRIkftaH -tA -taM, parigaRitaH &c.
NUMBERER , s. saMKyAkft m., gaRakaH, aNkagaRakaH, gaRanAkArI m. (n).
NUMBERING , s. gaRanaM -nA, parigaRanaM -nA, saMKyAnaM, saMKyAkaraRaM, gaRitaM,
NUMBERLESS: asaMKya (f. KyA): v. Innumer- -able.

Numbles, s. mfgAMtrARi.
NUMBLES , s. pl. (Entrails of a deer) mfgAntraM, mfgAntrARi n. pl.
NUMBNESS: (1) jAqyam;(2) stabDatA;(3) stammaH.
NUMBNESS , s. tvaksuptiH f., tvaksvApaH, suptiH f., svApaH, jaqatA, jAqyaM, cEtanyastamBaH, cetanAstamBaH, cEtanyastabDatA, cEtanyarAhityaM, gatiSaktihInatA, kuRWatA, midDaM.
NUMERABLE , a. saMKyeyaH -yA -yaM, gaRanIyaH -yA -yaM, gaRyaH -RyA -RyaM, gaReyaH -yA -yaM, gaRitavyaH -vyA -vyaM, parigaRanIyaH -yA -yaM.
Numeral, s. saMKyA, aMkaH. a. saMKyAtmaka, saMKyAvAcaka-vizaya, saMKyA in comp. [Numeral]ly, adv. yaTAsaMKyaM.
NUMERAL: (1) saMKyA;(2) aNkaH (= figure).

NUMERARY , a. amukasaMKyAsambanDI -nDinI &c., amukasaMKyaH -KyA -KyaM.
Numeration, s. saMKyAnaM, gaRanA.
NUMERATION: perh. saMKyAnam, pari- (after guRanam).
NUMERATION , s. saMKyAnaM, saMKyatA, gaRanA, parigaRanA, saMKyAparimARaM.

NUMERICAL: expr. by comp., n. strength: *saMKyAbalam.
NUMERICAL , a. sAMKyaH -KyI -KyaM, yaTAsaMKyaH -KyA -KyaM, saMKyApekzakaH -kA -kaM, saMKyoddeSakaH -kA -kaM, saMKyAsambanDI &c. See NUMERAL, a.
NUMERICALLY: (1) saMKyayA, pari-;(2) saMKyAnena, pari-.
NUMERICALLY , adv. yaTAsaMKyaM, saMKyAmapekzya, saMKyAmuddiSya, yaTAgaRanaM, gaRanAM kftvA, saMKyAM kftvA or gaRayitvA.
Numerous, a. bahu, bahusaMKya, bahula, BUri, aneka, pracura, nEka; See Many. [Numerous]ly, adv. bahuSaH, bAhulyena, anekaSaH.
NUMEROUS: bahusaMKya (f. KyA), -kaH (kA, kaM): v. Also many. Ph.: “n. verse”: CandobadDaM padyam.

NUPTIALS , s. pl. vivAhaH, udvAhaH, pariRayanaM, vivAhaviDiH m., vivAha- kriyA, vivAhasaMskAraH, pARigrahaRaM.

(pAlayati); yatnAdupacaryatAmasO (S. 3) ‘let her be carefully n(urs)ed’. 2 pA c. (pAlayati), puz 1, 4, 9 P, vfD c., lal 10; See Nourish. 3 dugDaM pA c. (pAyayati), stanyaM dA 3 U or De c. (DApayati). NURSE , s. DAtrI, DAtreyI -yikA, aNkapAlI, upamAtA f. (tf), mAtfkA, pratipAlikA, pAlayitrI, DanyA, papuH f. — (In sickness) upacArakartrI, upacArikA, rugnaparicArikA, rogArttapAlikA, rogasevikA. — (Fosterer, cherisher) pAlakaH, pratipAlakaH, pAlayitA m. (tf), pozakaH, pozwA m. (zwf).

To NURSE , v. a. (Foster, take care of a child, &c.) pAl (c. 10. pAlayati -yituM), pratipAl, aNke pAl, kroqe pAl, puz (c. 1. pozati, c. 9. puzRAti, c. 10. pozayati -yituM) or paripuz, kroqIkf, aNkIkf. — (Attend upon a sick person) rogiRam upacar (c. 1. -carati -rituM) or paricar or pAl or pratipAl or sev (c. 1. sevate -vituM) or upasev. — (Suckle) dugDaM or stanyaM or stanaM dA (c. 3. dadAti, dAtuM) or pA in caus. (pAyayati -yituM) or Ge in caus. (DApayati -yituM), stanadAnena or stanyadAnena puz or pAl. — (Nourish, cherish) Bf (c. 1. Barati, c. 3. biBartti, BarttuM), samBf, pAl.
NURSED , p. p. pAlitaH -tA -taM, aNke pAlitaH -tA -taM or pratipAlitaH &c., pozitaH -tA -taM, puzwaH -zwA -zwaM, BaritaH -tA -taM. — (In sickness, &c.) upacaritaH -tA -taM.

NUT-CRACKERS , s. pl. sandaMSaH, sandaMSakaM, sandaMSakA.

NYCTALOPY , NYCTALOPIA, s. rAtridfzwiH f., niSAdfzwiH f.
